odeComponent.htmlView:
by eXeLearning It is a free and open source software program.open sourceDesigned for the Creation and editing of interactive digital resourcesIt is a tool that allows you to incorporate a wide variety of contents - texts, images, videos, interactive activities or games - in a simple and structured way, offering a clean and attractive look.


by CEDEC. by eXeLearning 3.0 (CC by-SA)



The tool is available in two modes:

  • The installable version: to work locally
  • The online version: It facilitates the quick editing and publication of content on the platform in which it is integrated.

The resources created with eXeLearning have design Responsive, ensuring their correct visualization on any device, and can be exported in standard formats such as HTML, SCORM or EPUB3, which favors their dissemination on platforms and repositories.

In addition, eXeLearning encourages the creation of Open Educational Resources (REA)Promoting shared knowledge and open education.

The origin of eXeLearning dates back to the 2000s, in the framework of the project by eXeLearning.org developed in New Zealand. in 2010, the by INTEF (Then ITE) assumed the development and promoted by eXeLearning.net The initiative of the initiative, the coordination of by CEDEC Since then, it has been consolidated as a collaborative project in which users, public administrations and other entities participate.


Over the years, the tool has experienced significant advances, incorporating improvements and functionalities and increasing the user community. an online version has been developed, facilitating its integration with Moodle, and other developments have been made such as the eXeReader visor.

The version 3.0 represents a great jump in the evolution of the tool. It implies the total renewal of the code and interface and incorporates great improvements in usability and functionality (such as collaborative work in its online version).

This development and its continuous improvements are the result of a close collaboration between the MEFPD and the regional educational administrations of Spain.

odeComponent.htmlView:
The progress of eXeLearning is the result of a close collaboration between the Ministry of Education, Professional Training and Sports of Spain (MEFPD) – through the Cedec-INTEF – and various regional educational administrations, including Extremadura, Canary Islands, the Valencian Community, Galicia, Madrid and Andalusia.

The vitality of the project is also due to the active participation of your community, which contributes with contributions, errors and suggestions. The TelegramThere are doubts to be resolved and knowledge is shared openly.

The development of eXeLearning is managed fully openly in by GitHub, which acts as the project's neurological center. There, developers can:

  • To set up a local environment in minutes using Docker commands (docker run, docker execCloning the repository with git clone and use make up.
  • View the full documentation in the directory doc/.
  • Use the by makefile to simplify tasks such as starting / holding containers, running tests or updating translations.
  • by Forkear the project, create branches, make changes and send Pull Requests.

The GitHub community is always available to resolve doubts and receive errors reports in the issuesThis open management strengthens the collaborative and constant improvement of eXeLearning.

You can learn more about the project in the section. The eXeLearning Project on the official website.

The Online Version

  • Side column: contains the project title, the structure panel and the iDevices panel.
  • Central area: Content editing area.

odeComponent.htmlView:
This bar, located at the top, contains the essential tools for project management: Archive, Utilities and Help, as well as access to other features.

Menu Archive

From this menu we can open and save projects. you can open elp files (created with eXe 2), elpx files (Created with exe 3) and editable zip or SCORM files created with exe.

It also allows you to print and export them (in the desktop version) or download them (on the online version) in different standard formats. This includes web formats (HTML), e-books (ePub3) and educational standards such as SCORM or IMS, which are necessary to work with platforms such as Moodle.

In addition, in the case of the online version, by clicking open you can also access the latest saved files and their latest versions.

Menu Utilities

From this menu we can access the following functions:

  • Report of Resources: a table that contains all the resources (file, images, video, etc.) used throughout the project, indicating the page and box in which it is located.
  • Validation of links: a table that contains the broken links of the project, indicating the page and box in which it is located.
  • Manager of filesIt facilitates the insertion of complex content.

Menu of Help

It contains information about eXeLearning, the current version, legal notes, website and other relevant project information

Buttons and other accesses

In addition, from the top right of the interface, we can access the following buttons:

  • guardedKeep the project. Remember that all the idevices must be closed to be able to save.
  • Preview ofShowing the content in advance view, which is how it will be seen on the export Website.
  • StylesIt allows to change the style to one of the default installed or import a new one.
  • Configuration of the projectIt allows you to enter the project metadata, decide on the export preferences – such as adding a page counter, a accessibility bar or a search engine – or adding personalized code.
  • Sharing It makes it easy for several people to work on the same project at the same time by sharing the link to it.
  • User ProfileIt gives access to:
    • It allows to define the language and license of the contents.
    • Closing session / Exit.

odeComponent.htmlView:
This side panel is used both to organize the project as well as to access the content blocks that will be inserted into the pages.

Title


You can also introduce or modify the title in Project Configuration (top bar)

Panel of Structure

The structure panel allows you to organize the content in pages and subpages.The user can structure the content, allowing you to create new pages, delete them, duplicate them or reorganize them.

In addition, on each page the properties of the same can be modified.

From the Structure panel, the user can also import boxes or idevices to the page that is selected by clicking on the icon:

Panel of Devices

The iDevices (content blocks) are the central element of the tool. They are blocks or "puzzle pieces" that facilitate the incorporation of different types of content easily, including texts, images, videos, audio and interactive activities. In the interface, these iDivices are grouped into categories for their easy location:

  • Information and PresentationThey show information, organize resources or enrich content with accessibility and various means.
  • Evaluation and MonitoringThey offer questionnaires and other tools to check knowledge or advances, with option to give feedback.
  • The Games. They use game mechanics to motivate and strengthen learning without evaluative pressure.
  • Interactive activitiesThey require direct interaction, fostering active learning and trial error.
  • SciencesDesigned to work content of specific areas or topics.

By clicking on each of these sections, the iDevices in the category will be displayed.

odeComponent.htmlView:
This area is the main work space where the project content is built. To start creating, we click or drag the selected iDevice from the iDovices panel or from the favourite bar that appears at the bottom of the work area. The iDivices that appear on this bar can be modified by clicking on the wheel that appeares at the right.


Boxes vs iDevice

Each box may have an icon and associated title and may contain as many iDevices as we want.

When we drag a iDevice to the work area, we will be able to place it inside an already existing box (in or below other iDeviices) or directly in the pen. In this case, a box will automatically be created to contain it. Once edited and saved the iDEVice, we can edit the title and icon of the box.

Both the boxes and the iDevices can to edit, to clone, to eliminate, to move and to export from its toolbar, located on the top right of each. In addition, in the properties you can configure other aspects:

  • whether it is visible in export or not.
  • to be visible only in a teaching manner
  • Adding an ID to iDevice
  • Introduction to CSS
  • that appears minimised by default (only the boxes).

odeComponent.htmlView:
We will then explore two essential elements in the creation of resources with eXeLearning: the iDevices, which allow to incorporate and structurate interactive content, and the text editor, a fundamental tool to shape and format the information presented, including in a large part of the iSevices.


Editor of texts

However, before we see these ideas in detail, we will stop analyzing the features included in the Editor of textsIt is a key element of work that is present in many iDevices and that allows to introduce and format text content, include multimedia elements, structurate the text, incorporate mathematical or musical note or record audioIt is therefore fundamental and transversal in the creation of resources. we will see this editor in detail, showing its basic importance.


The Devices

The main element to incorporate content into the resources created with eXeLearning is the "iDevice" or content block. These iDevices allow to enrich the resources and give them life, enabling the incorporation of a wide variety of materials, from texts, images and videos, to digital objects, interactive activities or games. eXiLearning 3. 0 has integrated numerous new iDevices, which are conveniently organized in categories to optimize the content design process:

  • Information and presentation: To display and structure content, enriching it with accessibility and various means.
  • Interactive activities : Exercises that require direct interaction for active learning.
  • The Games: Resources that use lucky mechanics to motivate and strengthen learning without the evaluative pressure.
  • Evaluation and Monitoring: Tools to verify knowledge and progress, with the possibility of offering feedback.
  • and sciences: Designed specifically to work content of specific matters or areas

It offers a Main menu with additional features (Editing, Insert, Format, Table, Utilities) and Three rows of tools with various options that you can see the following image passing the mouse through the active areas of the same.

Showing the simplified or expanded bar

One one First line of tools for the basic edition of texts, such as black, cursives, format, size and source type, and color of the text or background. Its functioning is similar to that of any text processor, facilitating the incorporation of various materials.

The editor has a Second row which includes tools for formatting paragraphs (alignment, line jump, lists with vignets and ordered, definitions lists) and for inserting or removing hyperlinks and bloodlines or quotes.

The Third row It expands its capabilities by allowing the inclusion of texts from other sources, codes (HTML, mathematical label in LaTeX, syntax highlight), dynamic effects (acordeon, tables, carrusel) and multimedia elements such as images, videos, audio (grabed directly) and musical note. It is crucial for your ability to manage the content stick, offering options to paste text without format and thus avoid “waste” code, which is fundamental to keep the HTML clean and facilitate the creation of accessible content.

This icon allows you to put the editing zone on a full screen and return to reduced viewing.

We will see in more detail the benefits. more significant This is different from any text editor.

odeComponent.htmlView:
In eXeLearning we can copy and paste any text content using the keys Ctrl+C, Ctrl+X, and Ctrl+V. However, it is necessary to keep in mind that, when paste external content, it can be traced. The original document's "waste" code may cause problems later when modifying the format.

To avoid this, the "Picking without format" option is activated by default, so that once the text is paste from the Portfolios, you can give the desired format or include the links directly from the text editor.

If we need to stick with format at a time, we can disable this option by pressing the corresponding icon. We recommend in this case to clean the code by selecting the text and by clicking on the Main menu > Format > Cleaning format.

Remember that "Picking without format" taps the text without the formats, links or origin styles but it assures you that the text you’re taping is clean from the point of view of HTML. It won’t give you problems if you want to give it format or apply a style.

odeComponent.htmlView:
The "Definition List" allows us to create a list of terms or concepts in which the definition or explanation of them is hidden.

by REA

Open Educational Resources (REA) are learning, teaching and research materials in any format and support that exist in the public domain or are under copyright and have been released under an open license, which allow their free access, reuse, reorientation, adaptation and redistribution by third parties.


The open license refers to a license that respects the intellectual property rights of the copyright owner and provides permissions that grant the public the rights of access, reuse, reorientation, adaptation and redistribution of educational materials.

Free Software

Free Software (in English free software, although this denomination is sometimes confused with "gratis" by the ambiguity of the term free in the English language, so it is also used free software) is the denomination of the software that respects the freedom of all users who acquired the product and, therefore, once obtained the same, can be used, copied, studied, modified, and freely redistributed from several and forms.

According to its main promoter, the Free Software Foundation, free software refers to the security of users to run, copy, distribute and study the software, and even modify and distribute it modified.

Procommon

The Space Procommon It began its journey in April 2014 with the purpose of becoming a meeting place for the exchange of impressions and proposals on educational experiences and learning among teachers. At the same time, it was presented as a reference site for access to the Open Digital Educational Resources (REA) repository of the Ministry of Education, Professional Training and Sports and of the Autonomous Communities.

odeComponent.htmlView:
The FX button allows us to create multiple effects on our contents to structure the information and prevent that there is a lot of scrolling down.

by Acordeon

The "Acordeon" effect has the content within a list that can be displayed and collapsed by clicking on each title.

Spring

From 21 March to 20 June, spring marks the beginning of a more tempered climate after winter. During these months, temperatures rise gradually, days are prolonged and vegetation begins to develop rapidly. It is a stage in which the presence of pollen increases, which influences both agriculture and the health of allergic people.

Summer

Between 21 June and 22 September, summer is characterized by being the most hot season of the year in the northern hemisphere. Days are longer than nights, which generates greater exposure to the sun. It is a season linked to rest, holidays and outdoor activities, although it also involves risks such as drought or heat waves in some regions.

Autumn

From 23 September to 20 December, autumn presents a gradual decline in temperature and a reduction in daily light hours. It is common that falling leaf trees lose their sheet, leaving characteristic landscapes of brown shades and ocres. In many countries, this season also marks the start of harvests and winter preparation.

Winter

From December 21 to March 20, the winter is the coldest season of the year, with short days and long nights. In much of the northern hemisphere ice and snow are recorded, which influences transportation, agriculture and everyday life. It is a stage where heating use increases and is associated with important festivities such as Christmas and New Year.

It is a stage where heating use increases and is associated with important festivities such as Christmas and New Year.

by Carrusel

The "Carrusel" effect allows you to offer additional information by taking advantage of the space. 

Spring

From 21 March to 20 June, spring marks the beginning of a more tempered climate after winter. During these months, temperatures rise gradually, days are prolonged and vegetation begins to develop rapidly. It is a stage in which the presence of pollen increases, which influences both agriculture and the health of allergic people.

Summer

Between 21 June and 22 September, summer is characterized by being the most hot season of the year in the northern hemisphere. Days are longer than nights, which generates greater exposure to the sun. It is a season linked to rest, holidays and outdoor activities, although it also involves risks such as drought or heat waves in some regions.

Autumn

From 23 September to 20 December, autumn presents a gradual decline in temperature and a reduction in daily light hours. It is common that falling leaf trees lose their sheet, leaving characteristic landscapes of brown shades and ocres. In many countries, this season also marks the start of harvests and winter preparation.

odeComponent.htmlView:
Creating an acordeon type effect is very simple. for this we will follow the following steps:

We click on the buttonof the editor.

In the window that is displayed, we select the desired type of effect (Acordeon, Tables, Pagation or Carrusel)

The effect is selected, the edition of the same will be similar. a box will be created with two headlines (which we can edit to put the title we want) and two spaces to write content to show or collapse. we will be able to edit it and incorporate any kind of multimedia resource.

To create a new item from the list, we will write the title we want to incorporate and the desired content within the created FX box. We will mark the title and select the "Head 2" format option.

To change the effect, you just have to click on the FX button again and select another.

odeComponent.htmlView:
By clicking on the icon  There is a window with three panels:

  • by General: It allows you to enter an image through an URL or with the file of it.
    • For accessibility, it is recommended to fill the fields "Alternative Description" and "Title of the image".
    • To avoid the resource weighing too much, it is recommended to optimize the images before inserting them or use the option "Optimize image". With this option we will be able to define the weight and quality with which the image will be included in the project, improving the total weight of the project we are creating.
  • The advanced: Alignments and styles.
  • Title and Recognition: It allows us to refer to the authority, origin and license of the image.

By clicking on the insert/edit icon  There will be a window with 4 tabs:

  • GeneralIt allows you to enter a multimedia element through an URL or with a file, indicating, if necessary, the type of element, proportions and other reproduction options.
  • Title and RecognitionIt allows us to refer to the authority, origin and license of the video.
  • AttributesIt allows to modify the format by means of code.
  • SubtitlesIt allows you to add a subtitle file (extension .srt or .vtt) to a video uploaded from the local computer.

If what we have is a Code of insertionWe can use the option. :

This option is simpler, but if we want to add title, recognition or other attributes, it will be necessary to do so from the Insert/Editing Icon.

odeComponent.htmlView:
• By clicking on the mental map icon  A first window with the map data (Title, Dimensions, Options...). Once filled, we will click on "Open the Mental Maps Editor".
  • Then we can create our mental map. From the central idea (which we can rename by double-click) we will go creating as many branches as we want. We can create and delete branches with the Add and Delete buttons. In addition, from the Inspector panel we will be able to modify the size, style and color of text, as well as the color of the lines.
  • By saving we will be able to decide if we cut the image and define the proportion.
  • Finally, we will return to the initial window and click Accept.

odeComponent.htmlView:
Multiple blocks and buttons

We tell you what are the steps to follow to create a didactic sequence with eXeLearning:

Installation of eXeLearning

This is a free, open source tool, which is available in https://exelearning.net for the operating systems.

Create the structure

eXe allows you to create a navigable menu for Organize the contents on pagesThis menu has a hierarchical structure that we can organize according to our needs, with the nodes and subnodes we need. The menu will be available when exported as a website or when posting your content on a LMS like Moodle.

Adding the content

We can insert all kinds of materials, using the content blocks or “iDevices”. From the text editor we can include and format texts, add images, upload videos or audio, and embedded content created with other tools. Finally, we can choose the style of among the available, or create one personalized. Organization In terms of content, we bet on:

  • Start with one Activity of motivation, reflection or mobilization of previous knowledgepreparation for subsequent tasks.
  • Presenting the tasks to make with the corresponding explanation, facilitating, where appropriate, Links to documents or to websites for search for information or consultation, TIC tools necessary for the performance of the tasks (with link to a manual or tutorial) and, fundamental, the Instrument of Evaluation This will also serve as a guide for the students.
  • Added Activities of Reflection throughout the learning process, to work metacoginiation, better assimilate learning and enhance the competence of learning to learn.

Adding interactivity

We can enrich our sequence with Interactive activities Some of these activities leave trace in Moodle, so they can be used to qualify.

5.Save and publish

Once the sequence is finished, we can Save it in different formatsDepending on what we want to do with that material:

  • Save the resource in local, in a pendrive or in an external storage, and send it to the student for their consultation.
  • Published in Procommon To provide the students with the direct link.
  • It is a Moodle LMS platform.
  • Publish in other web spaces offered by educational institutions or other types 

Do you have doubts?

For any doubts or suggestions regarding the tool, we can consult the eXe manual or the The Telegram Group.

odeComponent.htmlView:
When selecting the iDevice "DUA Content" from the list of iDivices, the following will be shown in our eXeLearning:

As in the iDevice Text, we can optionally add:

  • A title, after saving the IDevice
  • A icon to choose from the available for the selected style (we remember that the DUA style is the one that most icons offers for this context, and has specific icons with colors associated with the type of DUA content we want to introduce)
  • A feedback section that will be deployed by clicking the button (the button text is also modified)

To include the content in this iDevice, in addition, we have many more possibilities:

  • First, we will choose the type of content we will insert according to the classification that the DUA makes: Implementation, Understanding or Expression. In some styles (such as DUA) some content will be differentiated from others by the associated color.
  • When incorporating the content, we can add as many blocks as we want. by default only one appears, but we may add more by clicking on the icon .
  • In each content block we are offered different possibilities:
    • We must decide whether we want the content we enter to appear directly (in which case we will leave the field "Button Text") empty or whether we otherwise want the contents to appeare by clicking on a button. In this case, we will have to indicate the text of the button and, if we want, associate the button with one of the available characters.
    • In the content box we are presented 4 tabs in which we can add the same content in different formats to facilitate the understanding of the same by all users:
      • Main content, where we will include our content (obligatory).
      • Facilitated reading
      • Audio
      • Visual support

odeComponent.htmlView:
A few months ago, it was announced what is considered by some "the greatest scientific discovery in history": the demonstration of the existence of the so-called Higgs Boson.

From this presentation, we propose you to carry out your own research on this topic from some activities.

Search for information:

We ask you to look for two or three internet pages where you can find information about the Higgs Boson: who was its discoverer, what theory he presented and where and how that theory has finally been demonstrated.

It is very important that you make sure that the sources of information you have found are appropriate and that you will be able to access them for a certain time, i.e. that they are stable pages.

The oral exhibition:

From the information obtained in the sources you have consulted before, you have to prepare an oral exhibition in which you explain the essential aspects about the topic we are working on.

The exhibition may not last more than five minutes. It is mandatory that you use some support resource. It may be a presentation that you have created or some material like that we have shown you to appear on the Internet.

Ferredoxin is a small protein that contains iron, which acts as the receptor of electrons associated with iron. Photo system I in the photosynthesisIt accepts an electron and is reduced, giving it the ability to transmit those electrons as part of the Process of electron transportationThe NADP+ reductase, catalyses the reaction in which ferredoxin is oxidated, and the NADP+ It is reduced to by NADPHThe NADPH has the energy as reduced coenzymeTo contribute to the The Calvin Cycle It is the main source of power reduction.

The The cell wall It is a resistant and rigid layer that supports the osmotic forces and growth, and is localized in the outside of the world. Plasma membrane in the cells of Plants, The Fungi, The Algae, bacteria and ArchaeologyThe cell wall protects the content of the cell, and gives rigidity to this, it works as a mediator in all the cell relations with the environment and acts as a cell compartment. In addition, in the case of fungi and plants, it defines the structure and gives support to the tissues and many more parts of the Cell.

The cell wall is built from various materials, depending on the class of organism. PlantsThe cell wall consists, above all, of a Polymers of Carbohydrate named celluloseand one PolysaccharideIt can also be used as a carbohydrate warehouse. cellIn the bacteriaThe cell wall is made up of by peptidoglucanoBetween the Archaeology cell walls with different chemical compositions, including The S of by glucoproteins, pseudopeptidoglicano or PolysaccharidesThe mushrooms have cell walls. by CITINA, and algae typically have walls built from glucoproteins and polisaccharides. however, some algaes species may present a cell wall composed of Silicium dioxideOften, other accessory molecules are presented integrated into the cell wall.

Ferredoxin is a small protein that contains iron, which acts as the receptor of electrons associated with iron. Photo system I in the photosynthesisIt accepts an electron and is reduced, giving it the ability to transmit those electrons as part of the Process of electron transportationThe NADP+ reductase, catalyses the reaction in which ferredoxin is oxidated, and the NADP+ It is reduced to by NADPHThe NADPH has the energy as reduced coenzymeTo contribute to the The Calvin Cycle It is the main source of power reduction.

The The cell wall It is a resistant and rigid layer that supports the osmotic forces and growth, and is localized in the outside of the world. Plasma membrane in the cells of Plants, The Fungi, The Algae, bacteria and ArchaeologyThe cell wall protects the content of the cell, and gives rigidity to this, it works as a mediator in all the cell relations with the environment and acts as a cell compartment. In addition, in the case of fungi and plants, it defines the structure and gives support to the tissues and many more parts of the Cell.

\n

The cell wall is built from various materials, depending on the class of organism. PlantsThe cell wall consists, above all, of a Polymers of Carbohydrate named celluloseand one PolysaccharideIt can also be used as a carbohydrate warehouse. cellIn the bacteriaThe cell wall is made up of by peptidoglucanoBetween the Archaeology cell walls with different chemical compositions, including The S of by glucoproteins, pseudopeptidoglicano or PolysaccharidesThe mushrooms have cell walls. by CITINA, and algae typically have walls built from glucoproteins and polisaccharides. however, some algaes species may present a cell wall composed of Silicium dioxideOften, other accessory molecules are presented integrated into the cell wall.

Ferredoxin is a small protein that contains iron, which acts as the receptor of electrons associated with iron. Photo system I in the photosynthesisIt accepts an electron and is reduced, giving it the ability to transmit those electrons as part of the Process of electron transportationThe NADP+ reductase, catalyses the reaction in which ferredoxin is oxidated, and the NADP+ It is reduced to by NADPHThe NADPH has the energy as reduced coenzymeTo contribute to the The Calvin Cycle It is the main source of power reduction.

The cytoplasma is the part of the protoplasm in an eucariotic and procariotic cell that is located between the cell nucleus and the plasma membrane. it consists of a very thin colloidal dispersion of granular appearance, the citosol or hialoplasms, and in a variety of cell organs that perform different functions.

Its function is to host the cell organs and contribute to the movement of these. citosol is the headquarters of many of the metabolic processes that are given in the cells.

The cytoplasma is sometimes divided into a gelatinous external region, close to the membrane, and involved in the cell movement, which is called ectoplasm; and a more fluid internal part that receives the name of endoplasms and where the majority of organs are found. The cytoplasma is found in the procariot cells as well as in the eucariots and there are several nutrients that have managed to cross the plasma membrane, arriving in this way to the organs of the cell.

It is an external and viscose layer It is very common in pathogenic bacteria because it facilitates adherence to the host’s tissues. It is not present in all procariots..

This capsule is rich in polysaccharides and protein molecules.

to the The bacterial capsule They are attributed to the following Functions:

  • fixed The bacteria is pathogenic to your guest.
  • Protect the bacteria The The decay of the medium.
  • It regulates the processes of exchange of water and nutrients, in addition to serving as a storage of nutrients.
  • Defense in front of a Anticorps, bacteriophages and The fagocytic cells.
  • It allows the formation of bacterial colonies.

The cytoplasma is the part of the protoplasm in an eucariotic and procariotic cell that is located between the cell nucleus and the plasma membrane. it consists of a very thin colloidal dispersion of granular appearance, the citosol or hialoplasms, and in a variety of cell organs that perform different functions.

\n

Its function is to host the cell organs and contribute to the movement of these. citosol is the headquarters of many of the metabolic processes that are given in the cells.

\n

The cytoplasma is sometimes divided into a gelatinous external region, close to the membrane, and involved in the cell movement, which is called ectoplasm; and a more fluid internal part that receives the name of endoplasms and where the majority of organs are found. The cytoplasma is found in the procariot cells as well as in the eucariots and there are several nutrients that have managed to cross the plasma membrane, arriving in this way to the organs of the cell.

It is an external and viscose layer It is very common in pathogenic bacteria because it facilitates adherence to the host’s tissues. It is not present in all procariots..

\n

This capsule is rich in polysaccharides and protein molecules.

odeComponent.htmlView:
By selecting the iDevice "Map" from the list of iDivices we get a series of options and tabs in our eXeLearning:

At the top, we will have the possibility, once the iDevice is saved, to modify the title of the iSevice and assign an icon. We see that there are a series of tabs, each with a different functionality that will allow us to configure our game in a very flexible way.

General Adjustments


The "General Adjustments" tab is the one that is displayed by default when creating the iDevice Map.

In this tab we will define the instructions to perform the game, the different settings and evaluation options available and the interactive activities and areas of the image we use.

  • By clicking on the section "Instructions"A text box will be opened where we will be able to specify the instructions to follow.
  • By clicking on the "Options" section we will be able to choose the type of activity or map evaluation we will create: Visited points, Identifying, Searching, Identify points, Questionary and Order.
  • In the "Map" section, once selected the type of evaluation - activity, we will have the option of:
    • Introduce a picture.
    • Enter an icon on that image that results in an information in the form of text, image, video, audio, presentation or another new map or interactive image. We will add a new point to the map by clicking on + 
    • In the event that you have selected the activity - evaluation type Questionnaire, you will show us a new field in which to create questions such as Select, Order or Word, similar to those of the iDevice Selecciona.

Contrasigns

In the "Contrasigns" tab, we will be able to create a challenge itinerary in which players will not be allowed to access a new game until they get a key in a previous activity. For this, we can set up an access code as well as a message that will be shown to players when they reach a fixed percentage of accidents, and that they will be allowed for use as a password for a new challenge or a subsequent activity. 

Both are optional, and your configuration will only appear if we mark them, as in the image.

Scorry

In the "SCORM" tab we will be able to determine if we want to save the results obtained by our students and in what conditions we want it to do when we export our contents.

It should be noted that this option of storage It will only be available for SCORM exports and when we publish our content on platforms such as: by Moodle or other LMS platforms compatible with SCORM.

personalized texts

Table where we will be able to customize the automatic texts and messages that the iDevice generates.

On the image we will be able to mark areas or areas through different types of icons. by clicking on them the student will be allowed to expand the information with text content, images, videos, audio, presentations or new maps - image, being the number of unlimited animations

From a series of questions, students will have to identify the answers on the icons located on the image or map.

From a series of questions, students will have to identify the answers on hidden areas of the image or map.

Each icon located on the image or map will show the student a series of questions.

The student must navigate for a minimum of contents on the map before being able to answer the questions.

The student must press the map points in the order indicated in the instructions.

The student must press the map points in the order indicated in the instructions.

odeComponent.htmlView:
When selecting the iDevice "Adivina" from the list of iDivices, we will be shown various options

In the top, we will have the possibility to modify the title and assign an icon, once the iDevice is saved. Finally, we will have the option to include a subsequent content. We see that there are a number of options and tabs, each with a different functionality that will allow us to configure our game in a very flexible way. 

General Adjustments


The "General Adjustments" tab is the one that is displayed by default when creating the iDevice Adivina.

In this tab we will define the activities proposed in the iDevice, instructions to perform the game, the different configurations and options and the definitions of the words or expressions that our students should know.

  • By clicking on the "Instruktions" section, a text box will be opened where we will be able to specify the instructions to follow.
  • By clicking on the "Options" section we will be able to configure from the time as maximum we give our students to answer every question, the percentage of letters to show, show the solutions in each question, as well as if we want to bargain the questions in each execution, the score system or if we wish to minimize the iDevice. It is also possible to decide whether we want to use the Digital Pizarra mode and the option to mark the Progress Report with your corresponding ID.
  • In the Words/Expressions section we will have the option to write the words and expressions with their corresponding definition, with the possibility to include audio, videos or images. No one, image, The video and The text.

In the case of introducing a VideoThe steps must be:

  1. Enter the URL of the video to enter
  2. Click on the Play button for the video to start playing (the video time will be displayed on the gray button)
  3. You can only play a fragment of the video. for this we will do the following:
    1. To indicate the start time, we will stop the video at the exact point we want to start (the time will appear on the gray button). Then we will click on "Start" (it will be marked with a blue edge) and then we will press on the grey time button. 
    2. To indicate the end time, we will stop the video at the exact point we want to finish (the time will appear on the gray button). Then we will click on "Start" (it will be marked with a blue edge) and then we will press on the grey time button. 
  4. We can also silence a part of the video, indicating the start time and duration.

Contrasigns

In the "Contrasigns" tab, we will be able to create a challenge itinerary in which players will not be allowed to access a new game until they get a key in a previous activity. For this, we can set up an access code as well as a message that will be shown to players when they reach a fixed percentage of accidents, and that they will be allowed for use as a password for a new challenge or a subsequent activity. 

Both are optional, and your configuration will only appear if we mark them, as in the image.

Scorry

In the "SCORM" tab we will be able to determine if we want to save the results obtained by our students and in what conditions we want it to do when we export our contents.

It should be noted that this option of storage It will only be available for SCORM exports and when we publish our content on platforms such as: by Moodle or other LMS platforms compatible with SCORM.

personalized texts

Table where we will be able to customize the automatic texts and messages that the iDevice generates.

Import and Export

In the “Import/Export” tab we can imported Questions compatible with this activity from txt or xml files (Moodle), or we can Exporting Questions in txt format to integrate them into other compatible activities.

IA

This tab allows you to bring questions from an AI chatbot in a simple way. So when opening it is shown to us, as an example a Prompt (model) that we can take to a chatbot that will generate questions in the appropriate format to be paste on the "Questions" tab. These questions proposed by AI will be added to the iDevice when we save ready to be used in the activity.

When selecting the iDevice "Form" from the list of iDivices, we will be shown various options

In the top, we will have the possibility to modify the title and assign an icon, once the iDevice is saved. Last, we’ll have the option to include a subsequent content. We see that there are a number of options and tabs, each with a different functionality that will allow us to configure our game in a very flexible way

General Adjustments

The "General Adjustments" tab is the one that is displayed by default when creating the iDevice Form.

In this tab we will define the activities proposed in the iDevice, instructions and options, as well as the questions that in this form our students must answer.

  • By clicking on the "Instruktions" section, a text box will be opened where we will be able to specify the instructions to follow.
  • By clicking on the "Options" section we will be able to configure from the time as maximum we give our students to answer the questions, the percentage of questions to show, show the solutions in each question, as well as if we want to barge the questions in each execution.
  • In the "Questions" section we find the possibility of adding the way we estimate questions of "True or False“from”filling the holes“in the form”Displaced“and”SelectionThis latter may have a correct response (Single mode) or several (Multiple mode).

ContentAll the contents are well organized and match the topic established. (4) TheThey are well organized almost all the contents and match the topic established. (2)It is not written correctly and does not comply with the ortographic and grammatical standards. (1)
personal importationThere are creative and original conclusions and contributions that give a personal touch to the work. We can create one from zero or load some of those that come as a model in eXeLearning.

In any of the two cases, we will be able to customize all the parameters:

  • The title of the rubric
  • Aspects to be valued
  • The performance levels
  • The Descriptors
  • The Weight of Each Descriptor
  • Also change the order and delete columns    and lines  and add new .

Once the rubric is created, we will be able to apply it to evaluate the student and print the valuations.

The following is detailed the process to use the Rubrica iDevice..

The new rubric

If we select "New Rubric", our starting point will be a 4x4 table that we will be able to complete and customize.

The rubber of example

If we select "Example Rubriques", we will be able to choose between several that are proposed (oral exhibition, video, infographic...) for their subsequent adaptation.

The predictions

Once the rubber is created, we will save  In forecasting we can see how the rubric will be seen and we will be able to use it to evaluate, by clicking on "Apply".

Application of the rubric

Once the corresponding alumni or alumna's rubric is filled, we will be able to print the evaluation or Save it as PDF.

odeComponent.htmlView:
When selecting the iDevice "Select" from the list of iDivices, the following will be shown in our eXeLearning:

In the top, we will have the possibility to modify the title and assign an icon, once the iDevice is saved. Last, we’ll have the option to include a subsequent content. We see that there are a number of options and tabs, each with a different functionality that will allow us to configure our game in a very flexible way

General Adjustments


The "General Adjustments" tab is the one that is displayed by default when creating the iDevice Selecciona.

In this tab we will define the activities proposed in the iDevice, instructions to perform the activity, the different configurations and options and the definitions of the words or expressions that our students should know.

  • By clicking on the "Instruktions" section, a text box will be opened where we will be able to specify the instructions to follow.
  • By clicking on the "Options" section we will be able to configure from the time as maximum we give our students to answer each question, the percentage of letters, show the solutions in each question (and play audio when showing it) as well as if we want to barrow the questions in each execution, the score system and the option to mark the Progress Report with its corresponding and identifier.
  • In the Questions section we will have the option of:
    • Choose the game system: select multiple answers (Selection), order the answers, or guess a word (Word).
    • In the first two cases we will be able to choose, as in other games, the type of multimedia element, as well as the number of options and time per query.
    • In the case of choosing "Word" as a game system, you will be able to set the percentage of letters to display and the time of question.

Contrasigns

In the "Contrasigns" tab, we will be able to create a challenge itinerary in which players will not be allowed to access a new game until they get a key in a previous activity. For this, we can set up an access code as well as a message that will be shown to players when they reach a fixed percentage of accidents, and that they will be allowed for use as a password for a new challenge or a subsequent activity. 

Both are optional, and your configuration will only appear if we mark them, as in the image.

Scorry

In the "SCORM" tab we will be able to determine if we want to save the results obtained by our students and in what conditions we want it to do when we export our contents.

It should be noted that this option of storage It will only be available for SCORM exports and when we publish our content on platforms such as: by Moodle or other LMS platforms compatible with SCORM.

personalized texts

Table where we will be able to customize the automatic texts and messages that the iDevice generates.

Import and Export

In the “Import/Export” tab we can imported Questions compatible with this activity from txt or xml files (Moodle), or we can Exporting Questions in txt format to integrate them into other compatible activities.

IA

This tab allows you to bring questions from an AI chatbot in a simple way. So when opening it is shown to us, as an example a Prompt (model) that we can take to a chatbot that will generate questions in the appropriate format to be paste on the "Questions" tab. These questions proposed by AI will be added to the iDevice when we save ready to be used in the activity.

The "General Adjustments" tab is the one that is displayed by default when creating the iDevice Selecciona.

In this tab we will define the activities proposed in the iDevice, instructions to perform the activity, the different configurations and options and the definitions of the words or expressions that our students should know.

  • By clicking on the "Instruktions" section, a text box will be opened where we will be able to specify the instructions to follow.
  • By clicking on the "Options" section we will be able to configure from the time as maximum we give our students to answer each question, the percentage of letters, show the solutions in each question (and play audio when showing it) as well as if we want to barrow the questions in each execution, the score system and the option to mark the Progress Report with its corresponding and identifier.
  • In the Questions section we will have the option of:
    • Choose the game system: select multiple answers (Selection), order the answers, or guess a word (Word).
    • In the first two cases we will be able to choose, as in other games, the type of multimedia element, as well as the number of options and time per query.
    • In the case of choosing "Word" as a game system, you will be able to set the percentage of letters to display and the time of question.

Contrasigns

In the "Contrasigns" tab, we will be able to create a challenge itinerary in which players will not be allowed to access a new game until they get a key in a previous activity. For this, we can set up an access code as well as a message that will be shown to players when they reach a fixed percentage of accidents, and that they will be allowed for use as a password for a new challenge or a subsequent activity. 

Both are optional, and your configuration will only appear if we mark them, as in the image.

Scorry

In the "SCORM" tab we will be able to determine if we want to save the results obtained by our students and in what conditions we want it to do when we export our contents.

It should be noted that this option of storage It will only be available for SCORM exports and when we publish our content on platforms such as: by Moodle or other LMS platforms compatible with SCORM.

personalized texts

Table where we will be able to customize the automatic texts and messages that the iDevice generates.

Import and Export

In the “Import/Export” tab we can imported Questions compatible with this activity from txt or xml files (Moodle), or we can Exporting Questions in txt format to integrate them into other compatible activities.

IA

This tab allows you to bring questions from an AI chatbot in a simple way. So when opening it is shown to us, as an example a Prompt (model) that we can take to a chatbot that will generate questions in the appropriate format to be paste on the "Questions" tab. These questions proposed by AI will be added to the iDevice when we save ready to be used in the activity.

odeComponent.htmlView:
When selecting the iDevice "Selecciona (multimedia)" from the list of iDivices, the following will be shown in our eXeLearning:

In the top, we will have the possibility to modify the title and assign an icon, once the iDevice is saved. Last, we’ll have the option to include a subsequent content. We see that there are a number of options and tabs, each with a different functionality that will allow us to configure our game in a very flexible way

General Adjustments


The "General Adjustments" tab is the one that is displayed by default when creating the iDevice "Selecciona (multimedia)".

In this tab we will define the instructions to perform the game, the different options and settings available and the questions with the clues we determine.

  • By clicking on the "Instruktions" section, a text box will be opened where we will be able to specify the instructions to follow.
  • By clicking on the "Options" section we will be able to decide if we want it to be shown minimized, the duration of the game, the number of attempts, if the solutions are shown, the time during which the cards are viewed, how much of the cards we want to be displayed in each round of the total tasks entered and the maximum number of cards. We can also define personalized messages, if we want the cards to be displayed in table mode or a feedback message to be shown (and from what score it appears).
  • In the "Activities" section, we will enter the enunciate (accompanied with image and/or audio if we wish) and the content of each of the cards, indicating for each if it is a correct answer:

Contrasigns

In the "Contrasigns" tab, we will be able to create a challenge itinerary in which players will not be allowed to access a new game until they get a key in a previous activity. For this, we can set up an access code as well as a message that will be shown to players when they reach a fixed percentage of accidents, and that they will be allowed for use as a password for a new challenge or a subsequent activity. 

Both are optional, and your configuration will only appear if we mark them, as in the image.

Scorry

In the "SCORM" tab we will be able to determine if we want to save the results obtained by our students and in what conditions we want it to do when we export our contents.

It should be noted that this option of storage It will only be available for SCORM exports and when we publish our content on platforms such as: by Moodle or other LMS platforms compatible with SCORM.

personalized texts

Table where we will be able to customize the automatic texts and messages that the iDevice generates.

odeComponent.htmlView:
When selecting the iDevice "Test" from the list of iDivices, the following will be shown in our eXeLearning:

In the top, we will have the possibility to modify the title and assign an icon, once the iDevice is saved. Last, we’ll have the option to include a subsequent content. We see that there are a number of options and tabs, each with a different functionality that will allow us to configure our game in a very flexible way 

General Adjustments


The tab "General Adjustments" is the one that is displayed by default when creating the iDevice "Test".

In this tab we will define the activities proposed on the iDevice, instructions to perform the game, the different configurations and options and the questions we will make to our students.

  • By clicking on the "Instruktions" link, a text box will be opened where we will be able to specify the instructions to follow.
  • By clicking on the "Options" link we will be able to configure from the way to display the iDevice, the number of lives, the score system, if we want to show the random questions and the answers to such questions as well the solutions to them after being answered. We will be able to include an introductory video at the beginning of the activity and the option to mark the Progress Report with its corresponding identifier.
  • In the "Questions" link we will have the option to create our questions accompanied by support multimedia, being able to choose up to four possible response options (only one will be valid) and the maximum time to answer. No Multimedia, image, The video and The text.

    In the case of introducing a VideoThe steps must be:

    1. Enter the URL of the video to enter
    2. Click on the Play button for the video to start playing (the video time will be displayed on the gray button)
    3. You can only play a fragment of the video. for this we will do the following:
      1. To indicate the start time, we will stop the video at the exact point we want to start (the time will appear on the gray button). Then we will click on "Start" (it will be marked with a blue edge) and then we will press on the grey time button. 
      2. To indicate the end time, we will stop the video at the exact point we want to finish (the time will appear on the gray button). Then we will click on "Start" (it will be marked with a blue edge) and then we will press on the grey time button. 
    4. We can also silence a part of the video, indicating the start time and duration.

Use of the icons  We will be able to create new questions, access the questions already made to edit them in addition to deleting, copying and cutting questions.

Contrasigns

In the "Contraseñas" tab, we will be able to create a challenge itinerary in which players will not be allowed to access a new game or challenge until they get a key in a previous activity. For this, we will be able to set up an access code as well as a message that will be shown to players when they reach a fixed percentage of accidents, and that they will be allowed to use as a password for a new challenge or a subsequent activity.

Both are optional, and your configuration will only appear if we mark them, as in the image.

Scorry

In the "SCORM" tab we will be able to determine if we want to save the results obtained by our students and in what conditions we want it to do when we export our contents.

It should be noted that this option of storage It will only be available for SCORM exports and when we publish our content on platforms such as: by Moodle or other LMS platforms compatible with SCORM.

personalized texts

Table where we will be able to customize the automatic texts and messages that the iDevice generates.

Import and Export

In the “Import/Export” tab we can imported Questions compatible with this activity from txt or xml files (Moodle), or we can Exporting Questions in txt format to integrate them into other compatible activities.

IA

This tab allows you to bring questions from an AI chatbot in a simple way. So when opening it is shown to us, as an example a Prompt (model) that we can take to a chatbot that will generate questions in the appropriate format to be paste on the "Questions" tab. These questions proposed by AI will be added to the iDevice when we save ready to be used in the activity.

odeComponent.htmlView:
When selecting the iDevice "Truthful or False" from the list of iDivices, the following will be shown in our eXeLearning:

In the top, we will have the possibility to modify the title and assign an icon, once the iDevice is saved. Last, we’ll have the option to include a subsequent content. We see that there are a number of options and tabs, each with a different functionality that will allow us to configure our game in a very flexible way.

General Adjustments

The "General Adjustments" tab is the one that is displayed by default when creating the True or False iDevice.

In this tab we will define the activities proposed in the iDevice, instructions to perform the activity, the different configurations and options and the definitions of the words or expressions that our students should know.

  • By clicking on the "Instruktions" section, a text box will be opened where we will be able to specify the instructions to follow.
  • By clicking on the "Options" section we will be able to set up the list of photographs, whether we put time for the questions or not, the random questions option and the option to mark the Progress Report with your corresponding identificator.
  • In the Questions section we will have the option of:
    • Write the questions/affirmations in a text box, marking whether it is true or false, with the option to add more questions.
    • A "Retroalimentación" tab with a text box
    • A tab of "Suggestions" with a text box

Scorry

In the "SCORM" tab we will be able to determine if we want to save the results obtained by our students and in what conditions we want it to do when we export our contents.

It should be noted that this option of storage It will only be available for SCORM exports and when we publish our content on platforms such as: by Moodle or other LMS platforms compatible with SCORM.

personalized texts

Table where we will be able to customize the automatic texts and messages that the iDevice generates.

Import and Export

In the “Import/Export” tab we can imported Questions compatible with this activity from txt or xml files (Moodle), or we can Exporting Questions in txt format to integrate them into other compatible activities.

IA

This tab allows you to bring questions from an AI chatbot in a simple way. So when opening it is shown to us, as an example a Prompt (model) that we can take to a chatbot that will generate questions in the appropriate format to be paste on the "Questions" tab. These questions proposed by AI will be added to the iDevice when we save ready to be used in the activity.

odeComponent.htmlView:
When selecting the iDeviceThe interactive video“from the list of iDevices we will be shown the following in our eXeLearning:

Let’s see what the content of these tabs is on the interactive iDevice Video:

The Video Editor

Once the video source on which we want to add interactivity is configured, we open the video editor, which has the following appearance:

There are two sections of options. On the top right we have the options to save and leave the edition., and below, at the right of the video are presented the following options:

to help: It shows a brief information with each of the editor's options.

Create a cover: It allows you to set a title and a small introduction or an image that will serve as a cover for the video. You can also include an image instead of a text.

Creating a photographIt allows you to introduce a photogram in parallel to the video to show information or generate an activity for the user.

The tool is very versatile and It allows you to create photographs of 8 different types:

The text

On the top right there is a The Help button which indicates us:

  • In which second the photo should be displayed (Started)
  • If you don’t want the video to stop, indicate when the photo should be hidden (Ended)
  • and push in To get the second current
  • The text: You can add lists, links...

The Note: The temporary configuration is similar in the rest of photogram categories, except in those where action is required by the user, where the option to stop the video will be mandatory.

image

Very similar to the text type in terms of operation, but only will allow us to enter an image, which will be displayed at the specified time. The end user will see the image and will be able to open it in a new window of his browser.

The unique answer

Multiple Answer

filling the holes

When selecting the iDevice "VideoTest" from the list of iDivices, the following will be shown in our eXeLearning:

In the top, we will have the possibility to modify the title and assign an icon, once the iDevice is saved. Last, we’ll have the option to include a subsequent content. We see that there are a number of options and tabs, each with a different functionality that will allow us to configure our game in a very flexible way 

General Adjustments


The "General Adjustments" tab is the one that is displayed by default when creating the VideoTest iDevice.

In this tab we will define the activities proposed on the iDevice, instructions to perform the game, the different configurations and options and the questions associated with the video that will visualize our students.

  • By clicking on the "Instruktions" link, a text box will be opened where we will be able to specify the instructions to follow.
  • By clicking on the "Options" link we will be able to configure if we want to show the random solutions and the time in which the solution will be displayed, the score system, the number of lives, if we need to minimize the iDevice or the option to mark the Progress Report with your corresponding identificator.
  • In the Question link we will have the option to enter a YouTube video or a file, write the questions and decide which second will appear to our students. The steps must be:
    1. Enter the URL of the video to enter
    2. Click on the Play button so that the video begins to play (the video time will be displayed on the gray button located below the visor)
    3. You can only play a fragment of the video. for this we will do the following:
      1. To indicate the start time, we will stop the video at the exact point we want to start (the time will appear on the gray button). Then we will click on "Start" (it will be marked with a blue edge) and then we will press on the grey time button. 
      2. To indicate the end time, we will stop the video at the exact point we want to finish (the time will appear on the gray button). Then we will click on "Start" (it will be marked with a blue edge) and then we will press on the grey time button. 
    4. To enter a question at a given time, we will proceed in the same way, selecting in this case the field "Question Point".
    5. We can also silence a part of the video, indicating the start time and duration.
    Use of the icons  We will be able to browse our questions, add new or delete them.

Contrasigns

In the "Contraseñas" tab, we will be able to create a challenge itinerary in which players will not be allowed to access a new game or challenge until they get a key in a previous activity. For this, we will be able to set up an access code as well as a message that will be shown to players when they reach a fixed percentage of accidents, and that they will be allowed to use as a password for a new challenge or a subsequent activity.

Both are optional, and your configuration will only appear if we mark them, as in the image.

Scorry

In the "SCORM" tab we will be able to determine if we want to save the results obtained by our students and in what conditions we want it to do when we export our contents.

It should be noted that this option of storage It will only be available for SCORM exports and when we publish our content on platforms such as: by Moodle, by eScholarium or LMS platforms compatible with SCORM.

personalized texts

Table where we will be able to customize the automatic texts and messages that the iDevice generates.

General Adjustments


The "General Adjustments" tab is the one that is displayed by default when creating the VideoTest iDevice.

In this tab we will define the activities proposed on the iDevice, instructions to perform the game, the different configurations and options and the questions associated with the video that will visualize our students.

  • By clicking on the "Instruktions" link, a text box will be opened where we will be able to specify the instructions to follow.
  • By clicking on the "Options" link we will be able to configure if we want to show the random solutions and the time in which the solution will be displayed, the score system, the number of lives, if we need to minimize the iDevice or the option to mark the Progress Report with your corresponding identificator.
  • In the Question link we will have the option to enter a YouTube video or a file, write the questions and decide which second will appear to our students. The steps must be:
    1. Enter the URL of the video to enter
    2. Click on the Play button so that the video begins to play (the video time will be displayed on the gray button located below the visor)
    3. You can only play a fragment of the video. for this we will do the following:
      1. To indicate the start time, we will stop the video at the exact point we want to start (the time will appear on the gray button). Then we will click on "Start" (it will be marked with a blue edge) and then we will press on the grey time button. 
      2. To indicate the end time, we will stop the video at the exact point we want to finish (the time will appear on the gray button). Then we will click on "Start" (it will be marked with a blue edge) and then we will press on the grey time button. 
    4. To enter a question at a given time, we will proceed in the same way, selecting in this case the field "Question Point".
    5. We can also silence a part of the video, indicating the start time and duration.
    Use of the icons  We will be able to browse our questions, add new or delete them.

Contrasigns

In the "Contraseñas" tab, we will be able to create a challenge itinerary in which players will not be allowed to access a new game or challenge until they get a key in a previous activity. For this, we will be able to set up an access code as well as a message that will be shown to players when they reach a fixed percentage of accidents, and that they will be allowed to use as a password for a new challenge or a subsequent activity.

Both are optional, and your configuration will only appear if we mark them, as in the image.

Scorry

In the "SCORM" tab we will be able to determine if we want to save the results obtained by our students and in what conditions we want it to do when we export our contents.

It should be noted that this option of storage It will only be available for SCORM exports and when we publish our content on platforms such as: by Moodle, by eScholarium or LMS platforms compatible with SCORM.

In the top, we will have the possibility to modify the title and assign an icon, once the iDevice is saved. We see that there are a series of options and tabs, each with a different functionality that will allow us to configure our report.

General Adjustments

In the "Options" section we will enter the identifier that determines which activities will appear qualified in the report. In advance, we will have entered this same identifier in such activities. We will also add the number of evaluable activities. In addition, we will be able to configure this report with different options: show date and time, show the type of iDevice, link the activities and enter user data.

odeComponent.htmlView:
When selecting the iDevice "Progress Report" from the iSpeed list, the following will be shown in our eXeLearning:

In the top, we will have the possibility to modify the title and assign an icon, once the iDevice is saved. Finally, we’ll have the option to include a subsequent content. We see that there are a number of options and tabs, each with a different functionality that will allow us to configure our list.

General Adjustments

In the "Options" section we will enter the Title and Subtitle of the rating list. We will be able to configure different options: display user data, remember marked options, assign scores, include logo or decorative images... We can configurate our rating list including activities of a different type:

  • The BoxA verification box will appear for students to mark it when they have done the specified activity.
  • The textA verification box will appear for students to mark it when they have done the specified activity and a text box to introduce content.
  • SelectedThe student must mark in a dischargeable if the activity is done, in process or without completion.
  • Not to mark: Only a text is presented, without the possibility of marking or entering content. This option is the recommended for titles of paragraphs or subparagraphs, for example.

personalized texts

Table where we will be able to customize the automatic texts and messages that the iDevice generates.

In the top, we will have the possibility to modify the title and assign an icon, once the iDevice is saved. Finally, we’ll have the option to include a subsequent content. We see that there are a number of options and tabs, each with a different functionality that will allow us to configure our list.

General Adjustments

In the "Options" section we will enter the Title and Subtitle of the rating list. We will be able to configure different options: display user data, remember marked options, assign scores, include logo or decorative images... We can configurate our rating list including activities of a different type:

  • The BoxA verification box will appear for students to mark it when they have done the specified activity.
  • The textA verification box will appear for students to mark it when they have done the specified activity and a text box to introduce content.
  • SelectedThe student must mark in a dischargeable if the activity is done, in process or without completion.
  • Not to mark: Only a text is presented, without the possibility of marking or entering content. This option is the recommended for titles of paragraphs or subparagraphs, for example.

personalized texts

Table where we will be able to customize the automatic texts and messages that the iDevice generates.

odeComponent.htmlView:
When selecting the iDevice "Search words" from the iServices list, the following will be shown in our eXeLearning:

In the top, we will have the possibility to modify the title and assign an icon, once the iDevice is saved. Last, we’ll have the option to include a subsequent content. We see that there are a number of options and tabs, each with a different functionality that will allow us to configure our game in a very flexible way 

General Adjustments


The "General Adjustments" tab is the one that is displayed by default when creating the iDevice Search words.

In this tab we will define the instructions to perform the game, the different options and configurations available and the questions.

  • By clicking on the "Instruktions" section, a text box will be opened where we will be able to specify the instructions to follow.
  • By clicking on the "Options" section we will be able to decide if we show the minimized game, time, if we display the resolution button, whether we accept words written in diagonal and reverse, a specific feedback at the end of the game if they have reached a certain percentage of accurate, the number of questions to show in the game and the option to mark the Progress Report with its corresponding and identifier.
  • In the “Words/Frases” section, for each of them we will be able to introduce:
    • The word to find in the letter soup and a definition of the same that will be shown on the side of the game.
    • A related image.
    • A word that describes the word

Contrasigns

In the "Contrasigns" tab, we will be able to create a challenge itinerary in which players will not be allowed to access a new game until they get a key in a previous activity. For this, we can set up an access code as well as a message that will be shown to players when they reach a fixed percentage of accidents, and that they will be allowed for use as a password for a new challenge or a subsequent activity. 

Both are optional, and your configuration will only appear if we mark them, as in the image.

Scorry

In the "SCORM" tab we will be able to determine if we want to save the results obtained by our students and in what conditions we want it to do when we export our contents.

It should be noted that this option of storage It will only be available for SCORM exports and when we publish our content on platforms such as: by Moodle or other LMS platforms compatible with SCORM.

personalized texts

Table where we will be able to customize the automatic texts and messages that the iDevice generates.

Import and Export

In the “Import/Export” tab we can imported Questions compatible with this activity from txt or xml files (Moodle), or we can Exporting Questions in txt format to integrate them into other compatible activities.

IA

This tab allows you to bring questions from an AI chatbot in a simple way. So when opening it is shown to us, as an example a Prompt (model) that we can take to a chatbot that will generate questions in the appropriate format to be paste on the "Questions" tab. These questions proposed by AI will be added to the iDevice when we save ready to be used in the activity.

odeComponent.htmlView:
When selecting the iDevice "Candated" from the list of iDivices, the following will be shown in our eXeLearning:

On the top, we will have the possibility to modify the title and assign an icon, once the iDevice is saved.We see that there are a series of options and tabs, each with a different functionality that will allow us to configure our game in a very flexible way

General Adjustments

The "General Adjustments" tab is the one that is displayed by default when creating the Candado iDevice.

In this tab we will offer the instructions of the activity, as well as the feedback that will be offered once the correct access code is indicated. 

This access code will be defined as well as the time available to enter it and you will be able to set the possibility of repeating the activity and the number of errors that will be permitted before the error message is displayed.

    personalized texts

    Table where we will be able to customize the automatic texts and messages that the iDevice generates.

    Scorry

    In the "SCORM" tab we will be able to determine if we want to save the results obtained by our students and in what conditions we want it to do when we export our contents.

    It should be noted that this option of storage It will only be available for SCORM exports and when we publish our content on platforms such as: by Moodle or other LMS platforms compatible with SCORM.

When selecting the iDevice "Crucigrama" from the list of iDivices, we will be shown various options:

In the top, we will have the possibility to modify the title and assign an icon, once the iDevice is saved. Finally, we will have the option to include a subsequent content. We see that there are a number of options and tabs, each with a different functionality that will allow us to configure our game in a very flexible way. 

General Adjustments

The "General Adjustments" tab is the one that is displayed by default when creating the iDevice Crucigrama.

In this tab we will define the activities proposed in the iDevice, instructions to perform the activity, the different configurations and options and the definitions of the words or expressions that our students should know.

  • By clicking on the "Instruktions" section, a text box will be opened where we will be able to specify the instructions to follow.
  • By clicking on the "Options" section we will be able to configure from the time as maximum we give our students to answer each question, the percentage of difficulty, show the solutions in each question among others, in addition to the option to mark the Progress Report with its corresponding identificator.
  • In the "Words" section we will have several options:

Contrasigns

In the "Contrasigns" tab, we will be able to create a challenge itinerary in which players will not be allowed to access a new game until they get a key in a previous activity. For this, we can set up an access code as well as a message that will be shown to players when they reach a fixed percentage of accidents, and that they will be allowed for use as a password for a new challenge or a subsequent activity. 

Both are optional, and your configuration will only appear if we mark them, as in the image.

Scorry

In the "SCORM" tab we will be able to determine if we want to save the results obtained by our students and in what conditions we want it to do when we export our contents.

It should be noted that this option of storage It will only be available for SCORM exports and when we publish our content on platforms such as: by Moodle or other LMS platforms compatible with SCORM.

personalized texts

Table where we will be able to customize the automatic texts and messages that the iDevice generates.

Import and Export

In the “Import/Export” tab we can imported Questions compatible with this activity from txt or xml files (Moodle), or we can Exporting Questions in txt format to integrate them into other compatible activities.

IA

This tab allows you to bring questions from an AI chatbot in a simple way. So when opening it is shown to us, as an example a Prompt (model) that we can take to a chatbot that will generate questions in the appropriate format to be paste on the "Questions" tab. These questions proposed by AI will be added to the iDevice when we save ready to be used in the activity.
