odeComponent.htmlView:
When selecting the iDevice "Development" from the list of iDivices, the following will be shown in our eXeLearning:

On the top, we will have the possibility to modify the title and assign an icon, once the iDevice is saved. We see that there are a series of options and tabs, each with a different functionality that will allow us to configure our game in a very flexible way 

General Adjustments

The "General Adjustments" tab is the one that is displayed by default when creating the iDevice Challenge.

In this tab we will define the activities proposed in the iDevice, instructions to perform the game, the different configurations and options and the definitions of the words or expressions that our students should know.

  • By clicking on the "Instruktions" section, a text box will be opened where we will be able to specify the instructions to follow.
  • By clicking on the "Options" section we will be able to define whether we want to minimize the iDevice and the option to mark the Progress Report with your corresponding ID.

  • In the Questions section we have two tables: The Challengein which the challenge to which the players will face will be explained and the time they have to introduce the final response, and Challenges, where they will go defining the different intermediate challenges that players must continue to overcome. In these challenges you can define up to 3 pistes that will go appearing past the time defined for each of them.


personalized texts

Table where we will be able to customize the automatic texts and messages that the iDevice generates.

Scorry

In the "SCORM" tab we will be able to determine if we want to save the results obtained by our students and in what conditions we want it to do when we export our contents.

It should be noted that this option of storage It will only be available for SCORM exports and when we publish our content on platforms such as: by Moodle or other LMS platforms compatible with SCORM.

odeComponent.htmlView:
We will use this device for Create games in which players will have to discover couples, trios or quarters of cards with images, texts and/or sounds.

According to the level of difficulty the games will be able to create games with different options, equal for couples, trios or quarters:

  • level The initial: Enable to play directly without the middle level or advanced screen option
  • level The Middle: It allows you to play directly with the initial or advanced level option on screen
  • level advancedIt allows you to play directly with options from any level on the screen.

  • level The initial: Enable to play directly without the middle level or advanced screen option
  • level The Middle: It allows you to play directly with the initial or advanced level option on screen
  • level advancedIt allows you to play directly with options from any level on the screen.

odeComponent.htmlView:
When selecting the iDevice "Discover" from the list of iDivices, the following will be shown in our eXeLearning:

In the top, we will have the possibility to modify the title and assign an icon, once the iDevice is saved. Last, we’ll have the option to include a subsequent content. We see that there are a number of options and tabs, each with a different functionality that will allow us to configure our game in a very flexible way 

General Adjustments

The "General Adjustments" tab is the one that is displayed by default when creating the Discover iDevice.

In this tab we will define the instructions to perform the game, the different options and configurations available.

  • By clicking on the "Instruktions" section, a text box will be opened where we will be able to specify the instructions to follow.
  • By clicking on the "Options" section we will be able to decide if it is shown minimized the start, choose the type of game (parts, trials or quarters) and the difficulty level of 1 to 3, the option to keep the cards visible for a certain time, the possibility to customize the error or correct messages, the time of game or the number of attempts. It is also possible to show or not the solutions, the feedback option that allows you to define the message to return, the percentage of questions to overcome the game, the authority and the option to mark the Progress Report with your corresponding identificator.
  • In the "Parejas" section and according to our choice by couple, trio or quarter, for each of them we will be able to introduce:
    • The text / image / audio of the first couple, trio or quarter.
    • The text / image / audio of the second pair, trio or quarter.
    • Third, fourth and so on.

Contrasigns

In the "Contrasigns" tab, we will be able to create a challenge itinerary in which players will not be allowed to access a new game until they get a key in a previous activity. For this, we can set up an access code as well as a message that will be shown to players when they reach a fixed percentage of accidents, and that they will be allowed for use as a password for a new challenge or a subsequent activity. 

Both are optional, and your configuration will only appear if we mark them, as in the image.

Scorry

In the "SCORM" tab we will be able to determine if we want to save the results obtained by our students and in what conditions we want it to do when we export our contents.

It should be noted that this option of storage It will only be available for SCORM exports and when we publish our content on platforms such as: by Moodle or other LMS platforms compatible with SCORM.

personalized texts

Table where we will be able to customize the automatic texts and messages that the iDevice generates.

Import and Export

In the “Import/Export” tab we can imported Questions compatible with this activity from txt or xml files (Moodle), or we can Exporting Questions in txt format to integrate them into other compatible activities.

IA

This tab allows you to bring questions from an AI chatbot in a simple way. So when opening it is shown to us, as an example a Prompt (model) that we can take to a chatbot that will generate questions in the appropriate format to be paste on the "Questions" tab. These questions proposed by AI will be added to the iDevice when we save ready to be used in the activity.

So when opening it is shown to us, as an example a Prompt (model) that we can take to a chatbot that will generate questions in the appropriate format to be paste on the "Questions" tab. These questions proposed by AI will be added to the iDevice when we save ready to be used in the activity.

When selecting the iDevice “Hidden Image” from the list of iDivices, the following will be shown in our eXeLearning:

In the top, we will have the possibility to modify the title and assign an icon, once the iDevice is saved. Last, we’ll have the option to include a subsequent content. We see that there are a number of options and tabs, each with a different functionality that will allow us to configure our game in a very flexible way

General Adjustments

The "General Adjustments" tab is the one that is displayed by default when creating the hidden image iDevice.

In this tab we will define the activities proposed in the iDevice, instructions to perform the activity, the different configurations and options and the definitions of the words or expressions that our students should know.

  • By clicking on the "Instruktions" section, a text box will be opened where we will be able to specify the instructions to follow.
  • By clicking on the "Options" section we will be able to configure from the time as maximum we give our students to answer each question, the percentage of letters, show the solutions in each question (and play audio when showing it) as well as if we want to barrow the questions in each execution, the score system and the option to mark the Progress Report with its corresponding and identifier.
  • In the Questions section we will have a number of simple options:

Contrasigns

In the "Contrasigns" tab, we will be able to create a challenge itinerary in which players will not be allowed to access a new game until they get a key in a previous activity. For this, we can set up an access code as well as a message that will be shown to players when they reach a fixed percentage of accidents, and that they will be allowed for use as a password for a new challenge or a subsequent activity. 

Both are optional, and your configuration will only appear if we mark them, as in the image.

Scorry

In the "SCORM" tab we will be able to determine if we want to save the results obtained by our students and in what conditions we want it to do when we export our contents.

It should be noted that this option of storage It will only be available for SCORM exports and when we publish our content on platforms such as: by Moodle or other LMS platforms compatible with SCORM.

When selecting the iDevice "Puzle" from the list of iDivices, the following will be shown in our eXeLearning:

In the top, we will have the possibility to modify the title and assign an icon, once the iDevice is saved. Last, we’ll have the option to include a subsequent content. We see that there are a number of options and tabs, each with a different functionality that will allow us to configure our game in a very flexible way

General Adjustments

The "General Adjustments" tab is the one that is displayed by default when creating the iDevice Puzle.

In this tab we will define the activities proposed in the iDevice, instructions to perform the activity, the different configurations and options and the definitions of the words or expressions that our students should know.

  • By clicking on the "Instruktions" section, a text box will be opened where we will be able to specify the instructions to follow.
  • By clicking on the "Options" section we will be able to configure the alertness, the percentage of activities, the feedback and the option to mark the Progress Report with your corresponding identificator.
  • In the Puzles section we will have the option of:
    • Choose the type of game: Slide or exchange the pieces, as well as select the number of rows and columns (minimum of 2 and maximum of 7)
    • Possibilities to show or not, images, number, time, or attempts.
    • Include the image, enunciate and comments or solution with your corresponding audio.

Contrasigns

In the "Contrasigns" tab, we will be able to create a challenge itinerary in which players will not be allowed to access a new game until they get a key in a previous activity. For this, we can set up an access code as well as a message that will be shown to players when they reach a fixed percentage of accidents, and that they will be allowed for use as a password for a new challenge or a subsequent activity. 

Both are optional, and your configuration will only appear if we mark them, as in the image.

Scorry

In the "SCORM" tab we will be able to determine if we want to save the results obtained by our students and in what conditions we want it to do when we export our contents.

It should be noted that this option of storage It will only be available for SCORM exports and when we publish our content on platforms such as: by Moodle or other LMS platforms compatible with SCORM.

odeComponent.htmlView:
When selecting the iDevice "Rosco" from the list of iDivices, the following will be shown in our eXeLearning:

In the top, we will have the possibility to modify the title and assign an icon, once the iDevice is saved. Last, we’ll have the option to include a subsequent content. We see that there are a number of options and tabs, each with a different functionality that will allow us to configure our game in a very flexible way

General Adjustments


The "General Adjustments" tab is the one that is displayed by default when creating the iDevice Rosco.

In this tab we will define the activities proposed in the iDevice, instructions to perform the game, the different configurations and options and the definitions of the words or expressions that our students should know.

  • By clicking on the "Instruktions" link, a text box will be opened where we will be able to specify the instructions to follow.
  • By clicking on the "Options" link we will be able to configure from the time as maximum that we give our students to perform the game, the number of rounds to the rock, show the solutions in each question, if we want to minimize the iDevice and the option to mark the Progress Report with its corresponding identificator.
  • In the "Words" link we will have the option to write the words and their definition.  The word we have defined will be requested that begins with the letter (A, in this case).We can ask from the definition, some word that contains the letter of the line in which we are clicking on the icon Likewise, we can incorporate an image that accompanies each word by clicking on the icon. 

Contrasigns

In the "Contraseñas" tab, we will be able to create a challenge itinerary in which players will not be allowed to access a new game or challenge until they get a key in a previous activity. For this, we will be able to set up an access code as well as a message that will be shown to players when they reach a fixed percentage of accidents, and that they will be allowed to use as a password for a new challenge or a subsequent activity.

Both are optional, and your configuration will only appear if we mark them, as in the image.

Scorry

In the "SCORM" tab we will be able to determine if we want to save the results obtained by our students and in what conditions we want it to do when we export our contents.

It should be noted that this option of storage It will only be available for SCORM exports and when we publish our content on platforms such as: by Moodle or other LMS platforms compatible with SCORM.

personalized texts

Table where we will be able to customize the automatic texts and messages that the iDevice generates.

Import and Export

In the “Import/Export” tab we can imported Questions compatible with this activity from txt or xml files (Moodle), or we can Exporting Questions in txt format to integrate them into other compatible activities.

IA

This tab allows you to bring questions from an AI chatbot in a simple way. So when opening it is shown to us, as an example a Prompt (model) that we can take to a chatbot that will generate questions in the appropriate format to be paste on the "Questions" tab. These questions proposed by AI will be added to the iDevice when we save ready to be used in the activity.

odeComponent.htmlView:
When selecting the iDevice "TriviExt" from the list of iDivices, the following will be shown in our eXeLearning:

In the top, we will have the possibility to modify the title and assign an icon, once the iDevice is saved. Last, we’ll have the option to include a subsequent content. We see that there are a number of options and tabs, each with a different functionality that will allow us to configure our game in a very flexible way

General Adjustments


The "General Adjustments" tab is the one that is displayed by default when creating the iDevice TriviExt.

In this tab we will define the instructions to perform the game, the different configurations and options available and the questions to select the answer or order of correct answers or expressions and words that our students must know from a definition.

  • By clicking on the "Instruktions" section, a text box will be opened where we will be able to specify the instructions to follow.
  • By clicking on the "Options" section we will be able to configure the number of themes in which we will categorize the questions, the option to show the minimized game, the possibility that the solutions to the questions are shown for a certain time and the option mark the Progress Report with your corresponding identificator.
  • In the Questions section we will have the option of:
    • Defining the name of the topics, categories or "quests" in which the questions that we will later create will be displayed.
    • Choose the game system: select several answers (Selection), order the answers, or guess a word (Word). Like the iDevice Select, we will be able to choose the type of multimedia element, as well as the number of options and time per question.. In the case of choosing "Word" as a game system, you will be possible to set up the percentage of letters to display and the time of question.

We should be very aware that the questions with your answers will be assigned to the topic or category in which we have created them. We can change them or category of questions by clicking on the number box.

Don't worry if you've been confused by creating a question in a category incorrectly You can copy the question, change category and paste it in the right category!

Contrasigns

In the "Contrasigns" tab, we will be able to create a challenge itinerary in which players will not be allowed to access a new game until they get a key in a previous activity. For this, we can set up an access code as well as a message that will be shown to players when they reach a fixed percentage of accidents, and that they will be allowed for use as a password for a new challenge or a subsequent activity. 

Both are optional, and your configuration will only appear if we mark them, as in the image.

Scorry

In the "SCORM" tab we will be able to determine if we want to save the results obtained by our students and in what conditions we want it to do when we export our contents.

It should be noted that this option of storage It will only be available for SCORM exports and when we publish our content on platforms such as: by Moodle or other LMS platforms compatible with SCORM.

personalized texts

  • By clicking on the "Instruktions" section, a text box will be opened where we will be able to specify the instructions to follow.
  • By clicking on the "Options" section we will be able to configure the source type, three levels of difficulty (the advanced with time control) and the option to mark the Progress Report with your corresponding ID.
  • In the Activities section we will have several simple options:

Contrasigns

In the "Contrasigns" tab, we will be able to create a challenge itinerary in which players will not be allowed to access a new game until they get a key in a previous activity. For this, we can set up an access code as well as a message that will be shown to players when they reach a fixed percentage of accidents, and that they will be allowed for use as a password for a new challenge or a subsequent activity. 

Both are optional, and your configuration will only appear if we mark them, as in the image.

Scorry

In the "SCORM" tab we will be able to determine if we want to save the results obtained by our students and in what conditions we want it to do when we export our contents.

It should be noted that this option of storage It will only be available for SCORM exports and when we publish our content on platforms such as: by Moodle or other LMS platforms compatible with SCORM.

We will use this device for Create games where players will have to classify cards with images, texts and/or sounds. different categories previously created.

Depending on the level of difficulty the games will be able to create games with different options:

  • level BasicThe card can be placed in any category, warns if it is right or wrong with green or red color respectively on the edges and gives a message of correct or error that can be customized.
  • level The MiddleThe card can be placed in any category allowing the mobility of the cards. By clicking on Check, the results and score will be viewed.
  • level advanced: Once placed the card in a category is immovable. Notify if it is good or bad with green or red color respectively on the edges and gives a message of correct or error that can be customized.

odeComponent.htmlView:
When selecting the iDevice "Classification" from the list of iDivices, the following will be shown in our eXeLearning:

In the top, we will have the possibility to modify the title and assign an icon, once the iDevice is saved. Last, we’ll have the option to include a subsequent content. We see that there are a number of options and tabs, each with a different functionality that will allow us to configure our game in a very flexible way

General Adjustments


The "General Adjustments" tab is the one that is displayed by default when creating the Classical iDevice.

In this tab we will define the instructions to perform the game, the different options and settings available and the questions with the clues we determine.

  • By clicking on the "Instruktions" section, a text box will be opened where we will be able to specify the instructions to follow.
  • By clicking on the "Options" section we will be able to decide the level of complexity of the game (basic, medium or advanced), add, or not, "Personalized Messages", define up to a number of four the names of the categories of what we want to classify, if we want it to show minimal start, game time, the feedback option that allows to define the message to return, the percentage of Questions to overcome the game, the authority and the option to mark the Progress Report with your corresponding identifier.
  • In the "Tags" section, for each of them we will be able to introduce:
    • The text / image / audio of the first card with its corresponding group.
    • The text / image / audio of the second card with its corresponding group.
    • Third, fourth and so on.

Contrasigns

In the "Contrasigns" tab, we will be able to create a challenge itinerary in which players will not be allowed to access a new game until they get a key in a previous activity. For this, we can set up an access code as well as a message that will be shown to players when they reach a fixed percentage of accidents, and that they will be allowed for use as a password for a new challenge or a subsequent activity. 

Both are optional, and your configuration will only appear if we mark them, as in the image.

Scorry

In the "SCORM" tab we will be able to determine if we want to save the results obtained by our students and in what conditions we want it to do when we export our contents.

It should be noted that this option of storage It will only be available for SCORM exports and when we publish our content on platforms such as: by Moodle or other LMS platforms compatible with SCORM.

Import and Export

In the “Import/Export” tab we can imported Questions compatible with this activity from txt or xml files (Moodle), or we can Exporting Questions in txt format to integrate them into other compatible activities.

IA

This tab allows you to bring questions from an AI chatbot in a simple way. When selecting the iDevice "Classification" from the list of iDivices, the following will be shown in our eXeLearning:

In the top, we will have the possibility to modify the title and assign an icon, once the iDevice is saved. Last, we’ll have the option to include a subsequent content. We see that there are a number of options and tabs, each with a different functionality that will allow us to configure our game in a very flexible way

General Adjustments


The "General Adjustments" tab is the one that is displayed by default when creating the Classical iDevice.

In this tab we will define the instructions to perform the game, the different options and settings available and the questions with the clues we determine.

  • By clicking on the "Instruktions" section, a text box will be opened where we will be able to specify the instructions to follow.
  • By clicking on the "Options" section we will be able to decide the level of complexity of the game (basic, medium or advanced), add, or not, "Personalized Messages", define up to a number of four the names of the categories of what we want to classify, if we want it to show minimal start, game time, the feedback option that allows to define the message to return, the percentage of Questions to overcome the game, the authority and the option to mark the Progress Report with your corresponding identifier.
  • In the "Tags" section, for each of them we will be able to introduce:
    • The text / image / audio of the first card with its corresponding group.
    • The text / image / audio of the second card with its corresponding group.
    • Third, fourth and so on.

Contrasigns

In the "Contrasigns" tab, we will be able to create a challenge itinerary in which players will not be allowed to access a new game until they get a key in a previous activity. For this, we can set up an access code as well as a message that will be shown to players when they reach a fixed percentage of accidents, and that they will be allowed for use as a password for a new challenge or a subsequent activity. 

Both are optional, and your configuration will only appear if we mark them, as in the image.

Scorry

In the "SCORM" tab we will be able to determine if we want to save the results obtained by our students and in what conditions we want it to do when we export our contents.

It should be noted that this option of storage It will only be available for SCORM exports and when we publish our content on platforms such as: by Moodle or other LMS platforms compatible with SCORM.

La célula (del latín cellula, diminutivo de cella, ‘celda’) es la unidad @@morfológica|mitocondria|cloroplasto|vacuola|ribosoma@@ y funcional de todo @@ser vivo|mitocondria|cloroplasto|vacuola|ribosoma@@. De hecho, la célula es el elemento de menor tamaño que puede considerarse vivo. ​ De este modo, puede clasificarse a los organismos vivos según el número de células que posean: si solo tienen una, se les denomina @@unicelulares@@ (como pueden ser los protozoos o las bacterias, organismos microscópicos); si poseen más, se les llama @@pluricelulares@@ .

La célula (del latín cellula, diminutivo de cella, ‘celda’) es la unidad @@morfológica|mitocondria|cloroplasto|vacuola|ribosoma@@ y funcional de todo @@ser vivo|mitocondria|cloroplasto|vacuola|ribosoma@@. De hecho, la célula es el elemento de menor tamaño que puede considerarse vivo. ​ De este modo, puede clasificarse a los organismos vivos según el número de células que posean: si solo tienen una, se les denomina @@unicelulares@@ (como pueden ser los protozoos o las bacterias, organismos microscópicos); si poseen más, se les llama @@pluricelulares@@ .

La célula (del latín cellula, diminutivo de cella, ‘celda’) es la unidad @@morfológica|mitocondria|cloroplasto|vacuola|ribosoma@@ y funcional de todo @@ser vivo|mitocondria|cloroplasto|vacuola|ribosoma@@. De hecho, la célula es el elemento de menor tamaño que puede considerarse vivo. ​ De este modo, puede clasificarse a los organismos vivos según el número de células que posean: si solo tienen una, se les denomina @@unicelulares@@ (como pueden ser los protozoos o las bacterias, organismos microscópicos); si poseen más, se les llama @@pluricelulares@@ .

odeComponent.htmlView:
When selecting the "Complete" iDevice from the list of iDivices, the following will be shown in our eXeLearning:

In the top, we will have the possibility to modify the title and assign an icon, once the iDevice is saved. Last, we’ll have the option to include a subsequent content. We see that there are a number of options and tabs, each with a different functionality that will allow us to configure our game in a very flexible way

General Adjustments


The "General Adjustments" tab is the one that is displayed by default when creating the Complete iDevice.

In this tab we will define the instructions to perform the game, the different options and configurations available and the texts with holes.

  • By clicking on the "Instruktions" section, a text box will be opened where we will be able to specify the instructions to follow.
  • By clicking on the "Options" section we will be able to decide the type of game (Complete, Arrange, Select and Select by limiting the words of each displaysable box), the number of attempts, the time, if we show the solutions, whether we allow errors, whether it distinguishes between major or not, proportionate sizes of the holes to the words they hide, whether you show the game minimized or simply if We give some kind of feedback when we get a percentage of good at the end of the game. 
  • In the Text section, once introduced the same accompanied by images, videos or any other resource that the eXeLearning editor provides us, we will hide the words or text chains we want to make use of the double drop at the beginning and end of each word or chain to hide.

Contrasigns

In the "Contrasigns" tab, we will be able to create a challenge itinerary in which players will not be allowed to access a new game until they get a key in a previous activity. For this, we can set up an access code as well as a message that will be shown to players when they reach a fixed percentage of accidents, and that they will be allowed for use as a password for a new challenge or a subsequent activity. 

Both are optional, and your configuration will only appear if we mark them, as in the image.

Scorry

In the "SCORM" tab we will be able to determine if we want to save the results obtained by our students and in what conditions we want it to do when we export our contents.

It should be noted that this option of storage It will only be available for SCORM exports and when we publish our content on platforms such as: by Moodle or other LMS platforms compatible with SCORM.

personalized texts

Table where we will be able to customize the automatic texts and messages that the iDevice generates.

odeComponent.htmlView:
When selecting the iDevice "Disturbed List" from the list of iDivices, the following will be shown in our eXeLearning:

In the top, we will have the possibility to modify the title and assign an icon, once the iDevice is saved. Last, we’ll have the option to include a subsequent content. We see that there are a number of options and tabs, each with a different functionality that will allow us to configure our game in a very flexible way

General Adjustments

The "General Adjustments" tab is the one that is displayed by default when creating the disordered iDevice List.

In this tab we will define the activities proposed in the iDevice, instructions to perform the activity, the different configurations and options and the definitions of the words or expressions that our students should know.

  • By clicking on the "Instruktions" section, a text box will be opened where we will be able to specify the instructions to follow.
  • In the "List" tab we will add the items in the correct order. The program will present them in a disordered way so that the student places them correctly. Instructions can be added to the beginning, and the text of the button and the feedback can be changed. The result can also be included in the iDevice Progress Report.

In the "SCORM" tab we will be able to determine if we want to save the results obtained by our students and in what conditions we want it to do when we export our contents.

It should be noted that this option of storage It will only be available for SCORM exports and when we publish our content on platforms such as: by Moodle or other LMS platforms compatible with SCORM.

Import and Export

In the “Import/Export” tab we can imported Questions compatible with this activity from txt or xml files (Moodle), or we can Exporting Questions in txt format to integrate them into other compatible activities.

IA

This tab allows you to bring questions from an AI chatbot in a simple way. So when opening it is shown to us, as an example a Prompt (model) that we can take to a chatbot that will generate questions in the appropriate format to be paste on the "Questions" tab. These questions proposed by AI will be added to the iDevice when we save ready to be used in the activity.

odeComponent.htmlView:
When selecting the iDevice "Identify" from the list of iDivices, the following will be shown in our eXeLearning:

In the top, we will have the possibility to modify the title and assign an icon, once the iDevice is saved. Last, we’ll have the option to include a subsequent content. We see that there are a number of options and tabs, each with a different functionality that will allow us to configure our game in a very flexible way

General Adjustments


The "General Adjustments" tab is the one that is displayed by default when creating the iDevice Identify.

In this tab we will define the instructions to perform the game, the different options and settings available and the questions with the clues we determine.

  • By clicking on the "Instruktions" section, a text box will be opened where we will be able to specify the instructions to follow.
  • By clicking on the section of "Options" we will be able to decide if we show the minimized game, if we activate the advanced game mode discounted to the student score every time it shows a track (if the advance mode is not activated, the student can access all the pistes and their final score will not be affected), if we display the questions randomly, if you show personalized messages, the solutions and the time, a specific feedback at the end of the game if you have reached a certain percentage of accidents, the number of questions to show in the game and finally the option to mark the Progress Report with your corresponding identifier.
  • In the "Questions" section, for each of them we will be able to introduce:
    • The statement or message of the question.
    • The solution.
    • A related image.
    • The number of attempts you can try to answer the question.
    • The number of clues that accompany each question.

Contrasigns

In the "Contrasigns" tab, we will be able to create a challenge itinerary in which players will not be allowed to access a new game until they get a key in a previous activity. For this, we can set up an access code as well as a message that will be shown to players when they reach a fixed percentage of accidents, and that they will be allowed for use as a password for a new challenge or a subsequent activity. 

Both are optional, and your configuration will only appear if we mark them, as in the image.

Scorry

In the "SCORM" tab we will be able to determine if we want to save the results obtained by our students and in what conditions we want it to do when we export our contents.

It should be noted that this option of storage It will only be available for SCORM exports and when we publish our content on platforms such as: by Moodle or other LMS platforms compatible with SCORM.

personalized texts

Table where we will be able to customize the automatic texts and messages that the iDevice generates.

Import and Export

In the “Import/Export” tab we can imported Questions compatible with this activity from txt or xml files (Moodle), or we can Exporting Questions in txt format to integrate them into other compatible activities.

IA

This tab allows you to bring questions from an AI chatbot in a simple way. So when opening it is shown to us, as an example a Prompt (model) that we can take to a chatbot that will generate questions in the appropriate format to be paste on the "Questions" tab. These questions proposed by AI will be added to the iDevice when we save ready to be used in the activity.

We will use this device for Create games in which players will have to order, phrases or cards with images, texts and/or sounds

Depending on the option we choose to order phrases or elements there will be one or another possibilities.

  • It is used to order a phrase that has been provided to the disordered user.
  • It is similar to the previous but with two possibilities:
    • Order multimedia elements that are disordered. 
    • Order multimedia elements that are disordered by fixing the head so that under this the rest is ordered.

odeComponent.htmlView:
When selecting the iDevice "Order" from the list of iDivices, the following will be shown in our eXeLearning:

In the top, we will have the possibility to modify the title and assign an icon, once the iDevice is saved. Last, we’ll have the option to include a subsequent content. We see that there are a number of options and tabs, each with a different functionality that will allow us to configure our game in a very flexible way

General Adjustments


The "General Adjustments" tab is the one that is displayed by default when creating the Order iDevice.

In this tab we will define the instructions to perform the game, the different options and configurations available.

  • By clicking on the "Instruktions" section, a text box will be opened where we will be able to specify the instructions to follow.
  • By clicking on the "Options" section we will be able to decide whether we will choose to order "frases" or "multimedia"
The Options (Frases)
  • In the option.”phrases"We will decide if it is shown minimized the start, the game time and the possibility of showing or not the solutions, the feedback option that allows you to define the message to return, the percentage of questions to overcome the game, the authority and the option to mark the Progress Report with your corresponding identificator.
  • In the section "Activities" option "Frases" we will be able to enter the phrase chosen to order
The Multimedia (Multimedia)
  • In the option.”Multimedia"We will decide if it shows minimized the start, the option to keep the cards visible for a certain time, the possibility to customize the error or correct messages, the game time. It is also possible to show or not the solutions, the feedback option that allows you to define the message to return, the percentage of questions to overcome the game, the authority, the number of columns that will be created to order with the fixed heads or the automatic start option.
  • In the "Activities" section in "Multimedia" we will be able to define what should be done in the enunciated with text or with an audio and add so many texts, images or audio as we want to order.

Contrasigns

In the "Contrasigns" tab, we will be able to create a challenge itinerary in which players will not be allowed to access a new game until they get a key in a previous activity. For this, we can set up an access code as well as a message that will be shown to players when they reach a fixed percentage of accidents, and that they will be allowed for use as a password for a new challenge or a subsequent activity. 

Both are optional, and your configuration will only appear if we mark them, as in the image.

Scorry

In the "SCORM" tab we will be able to determine if we want to save the results obtained by our students and in what conditions we want it to do when we export our contents.

It should be noted that this option of storage It will only be available for SCORM exports and when we publish our content on platforms such as: by Moodle or other LMS platforms compatible with SCORM.

personalized texts

Table where we will be able to customize the automatic texts and messages that the iDevice generates.

Import and Export

In the “Import/Export” tab we can imported Questions compatible with this activity from txt or xml files (Moodle), or we can Exporting Questions in txt format to integrate them into other compatible activities.

  • In the option.”Multimedia"We will decide if it shows minimized the start, the option to keep the cards visible for a certain time, the possibility to customize the error or correct messages, the game time. It is also possible to show or not the solutions, the feedback option that allows you to define the message to return, the percentage of questions to overcome the game, the authority, the number of columns that will be created to order with the fixed heads or the automatic start option.
  • In the "Activities" section in "Multimedia" we will be able to define what should be done in the enunciated with text or with an audio and add so many texts, images or audio as we want to order.

Contrasigns

In the "Contrasigns" tab, we will be able to create a challenge itinerary in which players will not be allowed to access a new game until they get a key in a previous activity. For this, we can set up an access code as well as a message that will be shown to players when they reach a fixed percentage of accidents, and that they will be allowed for use as a password for a new challenge or a subsequent activity. 

Both are optional, and your configuration will only appear if we mark them, as in the image.

Scorry

In the "SCORM" tab we will be able to determine if we want to save the results obtained by our students and in what conditions we want it to do when we export our contents.

It should be noted that this option of storage It will only be available for SCORM exports and when we publish our content on platforms such as: by Moodle or other LMS platforms compatible with SCORM.

odeComponent.htmlView:
We will use this iDevice to create games that relate concepts by joining them with sheets. Images, sounds and enriched texts can be used.

Depending on the level of difficulty the games will be able to create games with different options:

  • Basic level: Only let one card join your partner (there will always be a score of 10 when you end up joining all the couples).
  • Average level: One card is connected to another and then, by clicking on Check, the results and the score are viewed.
  • Advanced level: Similar to the average level but with a set-up time limit.

odeComponent.htmlView:
When selecting the iDevice "Related" from the list of iDivices, the following will be shown in our eXeLearning:

In the top, we will have the possibility to modify the title and assign an icon, once the iDevice is saved. Last, we’ll have the option to include a subsequent content. We see that there are a number of options and tabs, each with a different functionality that will allow us to configure our game in a very flexible way

General Adjustments


The "General Adjustments" tab is the one that is displayed by default when creating the iDevice Relationship.

In this tab we will define the instructions to perform the game, the different options and settings available and the questions with the clues we determine.

  • By clicking on the "Instruktions" section, a text box will be opened where we will be able to specify the instructions to follow.
  • By clicking on the "Options" section we will be able to decide the level of complexity of the game (basic, medium or advanced), if we want it to be shown minimized, the percentage of couples we want to be displayed in each round of the total of introduced couples, the authoritate of the play and if we like the result to be reflected in the iDevice "Progress Report" (indicating, where appropriate, the corresponding identificator; See the instructions from this iDevice).
  • In the section "Parties", for each of them we will be able to introduce:
    • The text / image / audio of the first card of the couple.
    • The text / image / audio of the couple's second card.
    • It also appears on the option of investing the cards.

Contrasigns

In the "Contrasigns" tab, we will be able to create a challenge itinerary in which players will not be allowed to access a new game until they get a key in a previous activity. For this, we can set up an access code as well as a message that will be shown to players when they reach a fixed percentage of accidents, and that they will be allowed for use as a password for a new challenge or a subsequent activity. 

Both are optional, and your configuration will only appear if we mark them, as in the image.

Scorry

In the "SCORM" tab we will be able to determine if we want to save the results obtained by our students and in what conditions we want it to do when we export our contents.

It should be noted that this option of storage It will only be available for SCORM exports and when we publish our content on platforms such as: by Moodle or other LMS platforms compatible with SCORM.

personalized texts

Table where we will be able to customize the automatic texts and messages that the iDevice generates.

Import and Export

In the “Import/Export” tab we can imported Questions compatible with this activity from txt or xml files (Moodle), or we can Exporting Questions in txt format to integrate them into other compatible activities.

IA

This tab allows you to bring questions from an AI chatbot in a simple way. So when opening it is shown to us, as an example a Prompt (model) that we can take to a chatbot that will generate questions in the appropriate format to be paste on the "Questions" tab. These questions proposed by AI will be added to the iDevice when we save ready to be used in the activity.

odeComponent.htmlView:
When selecting the iDevice "Memory Cards" from the list of iDivices, the following will be shown in our eXeLearning:

In the top, we will have the possibility to modify the title and assign an icon, once the iDevice is saved. Last, we’ll have the option to include a subsequent content. We see that there are a number of options and tabs, each with a different functionality that will allow us to configure our game in a very flexible way

General Adjustments


The "General Adjustments" tab is the one that is displayed by default when creating the iDevice Memory Cards.

In this tab we will define the instructions to perform the game, the different options and settings available and the cards to show.

  • By clicking on the "Instruktions" section, a text box will be opened where we will be able to specify the instructions to follow.
  • By clicking on the "Options" section we will be able to decide:
    • The type of game we’re going to propose (most, navigation, identification and memory)
    • In type "Memory" allows you to adjust the game time.
    • The option of showing the cards randomly.
    • Percentage of cards to show in the game.
    • Mark the Progress Report with its corresponding identifier.
  • In the section “Cards”, we can:
    • Introducing the reverse and reverse (the previous face, which will be shown by default and the later face that will be discovered by the student)
    • Use text, images and audio for each face

We will always have the possibility to invest the faces of a card or all of them by clicking on the corresponding links (Invest card, Invest all the cards)

Contrasigns

In the "Contrasigns" tab, we will be able to create a challenge itinerary in which players will not be allowed to access a new game until they get a key in a previous activity. For this, we can set up an access code as well as a message that will be shown to players when they reach a fixed percentage of accidents, and that they will be allowed for use as a password for a new challenge or a subsequent activity. 

Both are optional, and your configuration will only appear if we mark them, as in the image.

Scorry

In the "SCORM" tab we will be able to determine if we want to save the results obtained by our students and in what conditions we want it to do when we export our contents.

It should be noted that this option of storage It will only be available for SCORM exports and when we publish our content on platforms such as: by Moodle or other LMS platforms compatible with SCORM.

personalized texts

Table where we will be able to customize the automatic texts and messages that the iDevice generates.

Import and Export

In the “Import/Export” tab we can imported Questions compatible with this activity from txt or xml files (Moodle), or we can Exporting Questions in txt format to integrate them into other compatible activities.

IA

This tab allows you to bring questions from an AI chatbot in a simple way. So when opening it is shown to us, as an example a Prompt (model) that we can take to a chatbot that will generate questions in the appropriate format to be paste on the "Questions" tab. These questions proposed by AI will be added to the iDevice when we save ready to be used in the activity.

odeComponent.htmlView:
When selecting the iDevice "Mathematical Operations" from the list of iDivices, we will see the following in our eXeLearning:

In the top, we will have the possibility to modify the title and assign an icon, once the iDevice is saved. Last, we’ll have the option to include a subsequent content. We see that there are a number of options and tabs, each with a different functionality that will allow us to configure our game in a very flexible way

General Adjustments


The tab "General Adjustments" is the one that is displayed by default when creating the iDevice Mathematical Operations.

In this tab we will define the instructions to perform the game, the different options and settings available and the questions with the clues we determine.

  • By clicking on the "Instruktions" section, a text box will be opened where we will be able to specify the instructions to follow.
  • By clicking on the "Options" section we will be able to decide:
Do not activate the "Fractions" box (Elemental Operations)

The element to guess: result, operator, operators and random, the number of operations to perform and interval of numbers, the numbers of decimal in operators, the type of operation (sumes, remains, multiplications, divisions), and various options as to allow decimal results, negative, zero, errors... Likewise, we can limit the time for the performance of the activity.
It is also possible to mark the Progress Report with its corresponding identifier.

    Activating the “Fractions” box (Fractional operations)

    The element to guess: result, operator, operators and random, the number of operations to perform and interval of numbers, the numbers of decimal in the operators, the type of operation (sumes, remains, multiplications, divisions), and options as to allow negative or the irreductable fraction. We will be able to limit the time for the performance of the activity and the option is to mark the Progress Report with its corresponding identifier.

    Contrasigns

    In the "Contrasigns" tab, we will be able to create a challenge itinerary in which players will not be allowed to access a new game until they get a key in a previous activity. For this, we can set up an access code as well as a message that will be shown to players when they reach a fixed percentage of accidents, and that they will be allowed for use as a password for a new challenge or a subsequent activity. 

    Both are optional, and your configuration will only appear if we mark them, as in the image.

    Scorry

    In the "SCORM" tab we will be able to determine if we want to save the results obtained by our students and in what conditions we want it to do when we export our contents.

    It should be noted that this option of storage It will only be available for SCORM exports and when we publish our content on platforms such as: by Moodle or other LMS platforms compatible with SCORM.

    personalized texts

    Table where we will be able to customize the automatic texts and messages that the iDevice generates.

odeComponent.htmlView:
When selecting the iDevice "Matematics Problems" from the iDeVices list, we will see the following in our eXeLearning:

In the top, we will have the possibility to modify the title and assign an icon, once the iDevice is saved. Last, we’ll have the option to include a subsequent content. We see that there are a number of options and tabs, each with a different functionality that will allow us to configure our game in a very flexible way

General Adjustments


The tab "General Adjustments" is the one that is displayed by default when creating the iDevice Mathematics Problems.

In this tab we will define the instructions to perform the game, the different options and settings available and the questions with the clues we determine.

  • By clicking on the "Instruktions" section, a text box will be opened where we will be able to specify the instructions to follow.
  • By clicking on the "Options" section we will be able to decide:
    • Showing minimized, solutions and questions at random.
    • permitted errors.
    • Percentage of questions to show in the game.
    •  Option to mark the Progress Report with your corresponding ID
  • In the problem section, we will be able to introduce the different problems to be included in the game, taking into account that in its configuration we will:
    • Time to solve each problem
    • The mathematical expression that solves the problem (written in JSMath, see help links)
    • The enunciate of the problem in which the variables will need to be written to show the random numbers in JSMath.
    • Defining the number range that can be used when generating questions and whether we use decimal or not
    • Defining the domain of each variable 
    • Choose the smallest and the greatest of the numbers, or the number of decimal

Contrasigns

In the "Contrasigns" tab, we will be able to create a challenge itinerary in which players will not be allowed to access a new game until they get a key in a previous activity. For this, we can set up an access code as well as a message that will be shown to players when they reach a fixed percentage of accidents, and that they will be allowed for use as a password for a new challenge or a subsequent activity. 

Both are optional, and your configuration will only appear if we mark them, as in the image.

Scorry

In the "SCORM" tab we will be able to determine if we want to save the results obtained by our students and in what conditions we want it to do when we export our contents.

It should be noted that this option of storage It will only be available for SCORM exports and when we publish our content on platforms such as: by Moodle or other LMS platforms compatible with SCORM.

personalized texts

Table where we will be able to customize the automatic texts and messages that the iDevice generates.

When selecting the iDevice "Period Table" from the list of iDivices, the following will be shown in our eXeLearning:

In the top, we will have the possibility to modify the title and assign an icon, once the iDevice is saved. Last, we’ll have the option to include a subsequent content. We see that there are a number of options and tabs, each with a different functionality that will allow us to configure our game in a very flexible way

General Adjustments


The "General Adjustments" tab is the one that is displayed by default when creating the iDevice Periodic Table

In this tab we will define the activities proposed in the iDevice, instructions to perform the activity, the different configurations and options and the definitions of the words or expressions that our students should know.

  • By clicking on the "Instruktions" section, a text box will be opened where we will be able to specify the instructions to follow.
  • By clicking on the "Options" section we will be able to configure the mode (Part, Complete and Mobile), choose, names, symbols, groups, the number of questions and the of attempts, show the solutions and the option to mark the Progress Report with your corresponding identifier.

    Contrasigns

    In the "Contrasigns" tab, we will be able to create a challenge itinerary in which players will not be allowed to access a new game until they get a key in a previous activity. For this, we can set up an access code as well as a message that will be shown to players when they reach a fixed percentage of accidents, and that they will be allowed for use as a password for a new challenge or a subsequent activity. 

    Both are optional, and your configuration will only appear if we mark them, as in the image.

    Scorry

    In the "SCORM" tab we will be able to determine if we want to save the results obtained by our students and in what conditions we want it to do when we export our contents.

    It should be noted that this option of storage It will only be available for SCORM exports and when we publish our content on platforms such as: by Moodle or other LMS platforms compatible with SCORM.

    personalized texts

    Table where we will be able to customize the automatic texts and messages that the iDevice generates.

Once we have finished our material on eXeLearning, we have the most satisfactory moment, to make our project known to others.We will be able to publish it and share it in different ways depending on how we want to use it.


The resource we have created is kept with the extension by elpxIn order for the generated content to be viewed by other users and uploaded to different repositories, platforms or LMS, eXeLearning allows you to download or export the projects to different formats. 

In the event that we work with the online version of eXeLearning and is integrated into a platform or LMS, the publication on that platform will be as simple as clicking on a button.

eXelearning facilitates the download of the materials created in different formats, which allows to use them in various forms and in different contexts. There are some differences between the desktop version and the online, so we will see them

The Desktop Version

In this case, we will have access to our computer to be able to save the elpx file.We will be able To export the content in various formats:


Export formats available:

  • website: generates a compressed file (.zip) that contains the material organized on web pages. To view it, you need to decompress the file and double-click the file by index.htmlLocated at the root of the package.
  • Export in folder (decompressed website): export the project files and folders to the folder you indicate from your team.
  • Page alone: download a compressed file (.zip) that includes all the content on a single web page. Like in the previous format, it must be decompressed and open the file by index.html.
  • by SCORM 1.2: educational standard widely used to publish content on LMS platforms. It includes the content and metadata of the project and allows to track the progress and qualifications of the student. To visualize it, it must be charged on a LMS that supports SCORM, such as Moodle. It is the recommended version for this type of platforms
  • The IMS Content Package (IMS CP)Standard compatible with LMS platforms, which includes content and metadata. Unlike SCORM, it does not allow to track progress or collect qualifications.
  • by ePub3: Open format for ebooks. Unlike PDF, ePub files do not have a fixed page size, as the content adapts to the screen size of the device. In small screens it will be displayed in more pages, and in big screens, in less.

The Online Version

In this case, we will create our online project and we have several options to download it to our team:

Available download/export formats:

  • Content of eXeLearning and elpx: It allows you to download the project as a .elp file, edited directly on eXeLearning. This option is only available in the online version.
  • website: generates a compressed file (.zip) that contains the material organized on web pages. To view it, you need to decompress the file and double-click the file by index.htmlLocated at the root of the package.
  • Export in folder (decompressed website): export the 
  • Page alone: download a compressed file (.zip) that includes all the content on a single web page. Like in the previous format, it must be decompressed and open the file by index.html.
  • by SCORM 1.2: educational standard widely used to publish content on LMS platforms. It includes the content and metadata of the project and allows to track the progress and qualifications of the student. To visualize it, it must be charged on a LMS that supports SCORM, such as Moodle. It is the recommended version for this type of platforms
  • The IMS Content Package (IMS CP)Standard compatible with LMS platforms, which includes content and metadata. Unlike SCORM, it does not allow to track progress or collect qualifications.
  • by ePub3: Open format for ebooks. Unlike PDF, ePub files do not have a fixed page size, as the content adapts to the screen size of the device. In small screens it will be displayed in more pages, and in big screens, in less.

If what we want is to print or save as PDF our resource, we can use the "Print" option that appears in the eXeLearning menu. In the window that opens us by clicking on Print, we will select a printer (in case you want to print it on paper) or the option to Save as PDF (in the case you need to save it in this format).

In any case, we should remember that eXeLearning facilitates the creation of interactive content and that, both if printed and stored as PDF, the interactiveness and multimedia resources disappear.

odeComponent.htmlView:
Elpx files created with eXeLearning 3.0 have a significantly different structure than the elp generated with exe 2.9 and previous versions. As it is a recently launched version, many platforms and web environments are not yet prepared to work with this new file structure. However, it is expected that, over time, these platforms will be up-to-date to offer compatibility.

Meanwhile, we can use some alternatives that are already compatible, such as Moodle.

This list will be updated as new compatible platforms arise.

NOTE: The Procomun repository and the eXeReader app for mobile devices, used for the management and viewing of content created with eXaLearning 2.9, are not yet compatible with the content generated in the version 3.0 of eXoLearning.

We can upload the contents created with eXeLearning to a Moodle platform in different formats, such as Website, SCORM or IMS Content Package. In addition, if the Moodl platform has the online version of eXiLearning integrated through the eXaScorm and/or eXoWeb plugins, it is possible to create and edit contents directly from the LMS, without having to leave the platform.

In any of the two cases, we must have clear in what format we will present the materials in Moodle: SCORM, IMS or Website.

  • by Scorm: If we want to save the notes of the iDevices that has said option and follow the pages viewed by the student. we recommend exporting in SCORM1.2 since Moodle does not support SCORm2004 currently.
  • by IMS: If we just want to show the contents but we want that package to keep its metadata when uploaded to Moodle.
  • websiteThis is the most recommended option if we have not used the iDevices named above, since it offers a more attractive view as we can see below.

Posting content created with eXe on Moodle

In this case, we will upload to Moodle a content previously created in eXeLearning and exported as SCORM1.2, IMS or website.

Published as SCORM

The steps:

  1. We added a “Scorm Package” activity.
  2. We fill out the data and upload our SCORM package.
  3. We keep it.
  4. To view it, we click on the activity title and then on the Enter button. Moodle will use its own SCORM visor to display the resource, so the appearance may differ from how it was originally seen in eXeLearning.

Remember Moodle does not support SCORM2004, so we recommend making the export on SCORm 1.2.

Published as IMS

The steps:

  1. We added a "IMS Content Package" resource.
  2. We fill out the data and upload our IMS file.
  3. We keep it.
  4. Moodle will use its own IMS visor to display the resource, so the appearance may differ from how it was originally seen in eXeLearning.

Publishing as a Website

The steps:

  1. We add a “archive” resource.
  2. We fill out the data and upload our website file (.zip). 
  3. We click on the uploaded file. In the window that appears, we click on Remove. A series of files and folders will appear.
  4. We click on the file. by index.html And, in the window that appears, we click Configurate as the main file.
  5. Guarded
  6. To view it, we click on the title of the resource. In this case, we will see all the content with the menu and style defined in eXeLearning. 


Create and/or publish in Moodle with eXe plugins

The eXe for Moodle plugins facilitate the creation, modification and publication of contents from the LMS itself. The code of these two plugins (one for SCORM contents and another for contents in Website format) is published on the website. Official repository of GithubTo use them you need to have an eXe online instance, a Moodle platform and the plugins installed.

The operation is very simple. 

To create a content with eXeLearning from Moodle, we will enter a course within our platform and follow the following steps:

Step 1


We add an activity such as “eXeLearning (SCORM)” or “exeLeaching (Website)”.

Step 2

We write a title and leave selected the option “Create with eXeLearning”. If we need it, we can edit the configuration options (appearance, qualifications...). By clicking on “Save and Show” we will open eXE online and we will be able to create our material.

Once we have finished editing the material, we will click on the Finish button (set up to the right) and we will have it available in our course. 

Step 3

If we need to modify or continue with the edition, we will enter the resource and click on the “Edit with eXeLearning” button.

Step 4

We also have the possibility to publish and modify the package created with eXeLearning instead of creating it from scratch. For this, once selected the activity “eXe Learning (SCORM)” or eXiLearning (website)” we will choose the option of “Package uploaded” in the field “Pakage”.

Create and/or publish in Moodle with eXe plugins

The eXe for Moodle plugins facilitate the creation, modification and publication of contents from the LMS itself. The code of these two plugins (one for SCORM contents and another for contents in Website format) is published on the website. Official repository of GithubTo use them you need to have an eXe online instance, a Moodle platform and the plugins installed.

The operation is very simple. 

To create a content with eXeLearning from Moodle, we will enter a course within our platform and follow the following steps:

Step 1


We add an activity such as “eXeLearning (SCORM)” or “exeLeaching (Website)”.

Step 2

We write a title and leave selected the option “Create with eXeLearning”. If we need it, we can edit the configuration options (appearance, qualifications...). By clicking on “Save and Show” we will open eXE online and we will be able to create our material.

Once we have finished editing the material, we will click on the Finish button (set up to the right) and we will have it available in our course. 

Step 3

If we need to modify or continue with the edition, we will enter the resource and click on the “Edit with eXeLearning” button.

Step 4

We also have the possibility to publish and modify the package created with eXeLearning instead of creating it from scratch. For this, once selected the activity “eXe Learning (SCORM)” or eXiLearning (website)” we will choose the option of “Package uploaded” in the field “Pakage”.
